cards.name: RQ 20110129
cards.content:
{{+date}}

[[Don McClure|Don]], [[Lisa WilliamsCraig|Peri]], [[Joanie Albee-Good|Phasia]], [[Joe Good|Mel]], [[Brandon WilliamsCraig|Graves]], [[Tim Schlaak|Tarkal]], and Ted Greer (as Torath Keen Eye).

 

The episode begins with our intrepid heroes putting their feet up at home, at the end of their cul de sac. Food related riots and related violence are springing up all around the city.

 

Mel and Phasia procure a McCleary slave to caretake our house: Artos The House Boy. Mel requests Patsy IV in 2 weeks for a Rubble adventure at 100L. Peri and Graves go to Isthar The Maul, are received in the Nomad Room, and inquire as to his personal familiarity with Ganorta. Isthar serves bison broth with roots and recommends the party's attention to a tracker who is trustworthy and accustomed to the journey - Torath Keen Eye the Hunter. He may be found on the East side of the Zola Fell River in the wastes (only navigable for 1 day's journey north). Take a bow or arrow-related gift?

 

Here to there?  Sable Riders are getting their support from where? Rhino Riders might be North. Bisons beaten into the wastes. Impallas to the South.

 

Mel at the Humakt temple training Great Sword, preparing for high holy day in which they will reenact Humakt killing Flesh Man ceremony (during which one can sacrifice to get Sever Spirit). Offered various 10L/day gigs as a guard, etc. Tarkal, meanwhile, wanders aimlessly, gets a sauna and pedicure, and takes Peri and Phasia to dinner at Hotel Pavis. Mel buys Peri and Phasia 500L gifts and tithes 500L to Humakti temple before going out to dinner w Trea, blurting out the truth about his other spending, and then blowing 500L on her as well.

cards.name: RQ 20110226
cards.content:
{{+date}}

[[Don McClure|Don]], [[Lisa WilliamsCraig|Peri]], [[Joanie Albee-Good|Phasia]], [[Joe Good|Mel]], [[Brandon WilliamsCraig|Graves]], [[Tim Schlaak|Tarkal]], and [[Jeffrey Hohenstein|Jethro]].

 

Clay Stasis Storm cont'd

The Luau continues in our impromptu camp and steadily becomes a rowdy drunken pigmy hoohah of mostly Sable and Impalla Riders (we are not recognized), with dancing, instrumental music, and fermented sable milk (fsm). Graves teaches William to dance and drinks lots of fsm. When Phasia begins to feel the party has reached the A Bit Too Boisterous level she goes to the Troll camp to hang out, sit, and chat. The majority of the trolls at the Pairing Stones are self-selected to follow the oracle (who usually lives in the Lead Castle NW of here) and are very curious about Phasia. Why did the Oracle chose to speak to us when years long followers have yet to get a word from her? The Oracle is from the Mistress Troll Race (what they looked like before Gbaji's Curse. Long lived 300-500yrs).

 

Peri, drinking her own stuff, misses her Spot Hidden. Mel is watching and can tell that the situation is becoming raucous. Goes toward the Trolls and asks lots of questions about the surrounding territory, and answers questions (the Oracle likes me because I died more than most). Quickest route North is NW along the road to the City of Lead. From there, assuming cooperation, take an underground passage to northern end of troll territory. Hok writes a note on a piece of animal skin to help us ID ourselves later.

Halfway through the evening William has mastered a kind of shuttling back and forth dancing style.

 

Storytelling accompanied by music begins to happen:

Dog and Coyote (related to Pairing Stones) in God Time were fast friends and always had each others' back. Such good friends (dog guarded food for the humans) that Raven couldn't get to the food and lured Coyote and Dog away with bits of food, and then brought them to pool of forgetfulness where (because the food was salty) they were convinced to drink. Raven's Lie: you are friends (not cousins) and in the service of Raven. Started to use them to steal human food (consternation). No longer remembering their kinship they began to misunderstand their natural feelings of affinity. An evil spirit began to help a romance develop. A giant came to raid a farm. Dog wasn't there to warn the good Waha herder, who went to look for him. Evil spirit ripped Raven apart and continued. Humans fought and killed the giant and found Raven. Put him back together. Held him down and got the story out of him. As the Evil Spirit was about to get Coyote and Dog to consumate, Man/Waha killed the evil spirit with a  javelin (now the tree growing between Pairing Stones) and banished dog from plains of Prax forever.

 

Jethro makes roll to notice notes being played a bit off (something does not ring true about aspect of Giant's character). From the Trickster side there may be a bit more to be known. Figures out what the right notes might be. One other story has similar aspect. There is a cave to north used to bind secret marriages between members of different tribes. The similar aspect noticed was the theme used for the evil spirit.

 

FYI: an Earth Priestess from the Paps (far SW of Pavis) was the officient at the ceremony earlier. Peri now notes that seven priestesses are performing a ceremony looking down upon the dancing party becoming a mosh pit, and Fire Arrows the nearby barrel of lamp oil. When the priestesses notice (running around and screaming like girls) their ceremony is disrupted. Nobody hurt.

 

Wind Stasis Storm 1602

Morning nudge from William wakes Graves. Everybody begins to rise. Amazingly well organized area for having been a party. Another day of ceremonying looks to be in store.  Gr and Wi take a constitutional around the camp. Check 5 live tuskers still ready to go with us (cared for by Torath). Jethro researches other versions of the story (e.g. = morality tale - don't marry your sister). Mel contemplates a slower route not through City of Lead (Zorak Zoran might notice Torkal or Graves). There are no Stormbull around. Probabaly searching for the Eternal Battle as holy days are coming right up. Graves successfully picks Jethro's pocket, gets a thingamabob but is noticed, notices being noticed, fondles Jethro trying to give it back, and then puts it on his pack when Jethro simply shifts to playing a more jaunty "'Tis lovely to be fondled in the morning" tune.

 

FYI: we are over one week from Pavis.

We take road NW of City of Lead (the only real road). Jethro mentions to Phasia a beautiful young lady back in Pavis whose father won't let her wed him. He'd like to check out the Elopement Cave. Torkath has heard of it to NE as we enter the hills: "Blessed by some; cursed by most. Of the seven Praxian tribes only two (Impala and Sable) believe it is good; the others - bad. Tribes shouldn't intermarry but also bad things eventuall happen to those who marry there. A man and woman from the same tribe should never travel there together." Sands of Prax are behind us by quite a while. These are Badlands. Cool breeze from mountains. Just about to head over first hill. Standing far away in mid road - a Praxian Warrior dressed traditionally. He approaches. "I am Jald Tooth-breaker, spirit of Praxian Desert who died in te Battle of Pavis. I have returned to reclaim my own." Spirit pulls out of statuette. "Leave in peace and come back as needs be." Phasis loses 13 spell points and Praxian down to 10%.

 

Low green brush and exposed bits of rock. Shadows Dance Hills disturbing - in addition to regular shadows there are shadows that move around and don't line up with where sun should cast. Travel for most of day before Torkath lets us know that those going to the cave must bear NE as the road bears NW. The cave will be 4-5 hrs away and it is almost evening. Set usual guard and camp.

 

Fire Stasis Storm 1602

Lush land. Much cooler. Professional road made long ago but not by Trolls (above ground and well made) and still mostly intact large stone squares. Travel until half hour away from the cave area.

 

Tarkal, Phasia, and Peri keep a distance of 100m as Jethro, Graves, William, and Mel go toward it. Jethro begins playing a tune from last night. Music bounces around. An echo from jagged mountain seems to come back a bit different. Sounds a bit like th epart of the story wherin the pool is being drunk from which makes people forget. Graves listens and notices that the bounce back is the second part from last night. Jethro wanders toward the source. Graves uses arrow and bow as percussion and requests Mel follow. Open area with craggy rise. Jetrho stops playing and looks around. No obvious pools of water (we miss Spot Hiddens). Looking for pools of water, doors, ravens. Line of ravens sitting on rock. Jethro plays Raven tune, one takes wing, flies over head, craps on Jethro (dodges - sleeve only). Jethro plays rye variation. Ravens disperse in every direction. Jethro finds in rocks crude symbol - disorder rune. Mel looks for ravens. Jethro climbs up where they were and finds a small cave. Giddily calls us up. Mel and Graves try to climb and fail/fall. Mel -7 to left leg. Graves -4 to right leg. Mel heals Graves, himself, and throws rope up. Jethro mindspeaks w Phasia and ties rope. Mel climbs up. Then Graves.

 

Smallish cave mouth. Jethro tosses pebble in. Listens. Doesn't hear it hit. Mel casts Det Mgc on entrance. Positive in cave and on us. Jethro affixes rope to his ankle and crouches a bit to get into cave. Obvious pit instead of floor. Could dive over it. Chucks little rocks at walls and past pit where they disappear. Pit is actually floor. Mel follows and his 14 takes 5 damage when walking through the ward. Graves trades places (walking like a duck) and Mel takes 11 points through the ward again. Jethro gets some slack while Graves fixes his position to hold. Jethro jumps. Graves follows and lights his lamp. We take a long time to carefully descend to main cave. Small room clearly a Yermal shrine. Basin w water. Story in pictograms on wall. Small pewter cup. Jethro fills it and gives it to Graves who trosses it down, loses a permanent point of Power, and gets rune spell "Lie". Fills cup and gives it back to Jethro. Same effect. Story in cave tells of Raven wanting food, tricking coyote, convinces giant to attack human, plays dead, etc. gets what he wants and stops real Big Bad from happening. Jethro prays as initiate and Graves gets to watch (learning by dysfunctional hazing). We go to "real" cave. Pretty grotto, carving in white alabaster, man and woman intertwined, great place to have sex. Naughty bits everywhere. Return to party.

 

Wild Stasis Storm 1602

Travel for a couple of days. Graves begins watching flute playing carefully in order to learn from Jethro.

 

Freeze Movement Storm 1602

Castle of Lead in the distance. Amazing to behold. Walls literally made of solid lead to withstand a war of the gods. Pee your pants amazing. Mel walks ahead w Phasia and 1 pig, bear arms displaying troll-friend mark. "I bring food and wish to speak." Big troll in lead armor strides out, hits pig on head (now we have 4), takes pig in and motions to follow. Organized differently - like a city, actual society. All above ground = strictly battlements. Real city underground. Takes tusker and reports to priestess who permits us to stay. Mel asks to speak to P'tooie family in Saliva Tribe as instructed by Hok. Trollkin grabbed to be guide. Going underground. Thorougfare w troll traders and tunnels going in all directions with low ceilings. We approach a dark troll merchant selling outside world stuff. We buy a parasol (4L) and change 10L into bolgs (1000 or 5lbs of lead), ask about light (keep it low), don't make eye contact with any of The Mistress Race in this city (5 kinds of MR). Graves begins working with bits of wood to carve a flute (woodworking).

 

We are lead to houses of P'tooie. Mel gives the trollkin a bolg, knocks on door w Phasia. Trollkin answers. Sent for mistress. Female comes out. Phasia speaks to intro Mel. She covers and welcomes us. Mel gifts her w pig (now we have 3). She shows us the things we may touch and not (or be killed). We translate for Jethro. She worries. We take responsibility as Mel agrees that it would be lovely if they have to kill Jethro, who smiles and nods agreeably. Sits us down to eat (!). Graves eats heartily while all else but Tarkal try not to poison themselves while two juvenile trolls (!) look on. Phasia speaks of our context and the story of the Oracle speaking to us. Now we must stay for a final meal to which She Troll will invite guests. Over the course of the meal she admires Graves' appetite (as he belongs to the Clean Troll Plate Club). Phasia begs boon of nortbound tunnel guide. She agrees and asks what the Oracle said to us. Phasia tells her. Apparently, a bunch of trolls would like to walk with us. Jethro is about to barf, so he plays flute. She wonders about it being a common human custom at meals. She makes it into a lesson for the kids.

 

The fortress was built by the hand of Kyger Litor herself who must always wait for a musician to finish before responding (for instance, killing them). As the night wears on they are preparing for a major impromtu party - 4 large tables. Big pig centerpiece. Hard drinking. Chest butting games. Eating even more. City has 6000 trolls in it. How well known is The Oracle? Even Bros and Sis from the Stick know of her, as she is the most travelled of the Mistress Trolls of the city. Headed for Ganorta we must plan to travel through the pass at Dagor Inkoth, then East to Valley of Hammers, then a bit South. There will be Dwarves.

 

Dinner time, then story time and the excellent oratory of Phasia, who emphasizes our way through Vale of Flowers, then fabulousness of destruction of Chaos Bat in Temple of Chaos and report on Rockbiter warriors who had fallen, Windlord's armor, eating the dead, as right and proper, receiving trollfriend marks. Much thumping ensues. Mel segues into wandering the ruins of Pavis and slaying slimy cowardly Elves, whose Runelord we slew and took his armor. Bad roll and some polite thumping. They ask what the Oracle said. Phasia waxes awesomely. Many (two dozen) volunteers offer to escort us North. Joray, the Argan Argar, bounds happily out of the room to prepare.

 

Water Movement Storm 1602

Evening: sizable group leaves with us (as Joray argues that the road will be safe and he needn't pay any guards).

 

Phasia, Graves, and Joray talk trading while walking: they trade with humans to south and north. Trolls value things that they need which don't offend their own culture. He tells story of AA. Many were driven underground as protection from chaos above. Three went in search of the Light of Knowledge. KL (blinded and first to turn back) ZU (second to turn back) and AA went on to the end. Insanely valuable bits of True Stone (what Glorantha is truly made of and turned into adamantine or patterened so even the smallest fleck may have as much magic cast on it as can be cast in a moment - and then the spells can be recast over and over whenever) from dwarves. Services more than goods. Ritual magics. Troll priests and sorcerers permitted in City of Lead. Dwarves believe religiously that all True Stone everywhere belongs to them and do anything to get it. The Block in Prax (under which The Devil is imprisoned and from which he leaks) is made of True Stone.

 

Travel until God Movement Storm 1602, the edge of Troll lands. We could go up from here with Trolls, or they can give us a map to continue. We head for the surface. The area is snap cold - visible breath. We don our warm skins. We have two weeks of trail rations, three pigs, and still have our barbarian to carry stuff.

TCE scheduled for completion May 31st
Six major tasks (+project management):
1) Gathering info and research (almost done - need to get db together - 150 names community based Environmental Justice, Landuse and Transport, Public Health

Officials/Advocates who have not been talking to each other) (decide on what maps we will use/deliver - two types - statewide showing where people of color live in

500 municipalities in California - Regional scale w same info) (We have health priority areas maps already but challenge - shows ten highest priority for public health

intervention with seven in central valley where we haven't been working. SB375 has an urban focus and is not as good in rural places because reducing CO2

emmisions where people must drive further to function)(need to collect/finish organizing our own info we need to make the case we will make)
2) Design toolkit
== 6 Big wins plus overview of how it relates to transportation planning 2,500 words plus six fact sheets (one or two sides of a page 300-500 words each) w description, health implications, what you can do
3) Three workshops to evaluate toolkit (see below)
4) Distribute toolkit electronically (print and web deployment as discussed w Dennis plus)
5) Develop and Recommend at least three public policies (6 Big Wins and maybe others)
6) At public bodies/meetings present in support of the policies (at least three minute policy brief and probably PowerPoint)

Two projects related to this

1) Help develop messages around Climate Change and Public Health
2) Webinar focussed on SB 375 relationship to public health
3) Develop four digital stories linking Climate Change, Public Health, and spokespeople of color

Help San Diego Region develop a strategy fo rengagin communities of color in implementaiton of SB375
3mil population. A bit more than half of color, mostly Latino. Participation in planning for SB375 has been less than desired in terms of number of people/orgs and

actual outcomes.
Deliverable: Gather information and research on community needs and opprtunities address by SB375 and the state of implementaion of the SB375 process in San

Diego. Grant Proposal suggest a trip to San Diego to present findings to community based group. Synthesized into strategy document - how they should proceed to

engage communties of color in this process.

Before March 15th turn in interim report - 10 page document and financial report

cards.name: RQ 20110312
cards.content:
{{+date}}

[[Don McClure|Don]], [[Lisa WilliamsCraig|Peri]], [[Joanie Albee-Good|Phasia]], [[Joe Good|Mel]], [[Brandon WilliamsCraig|Graves]], [[Tim Schlaak|Tarkal]], and [[Ted Greer|Torath Keen Eye]]

 

 

Last game: traveled until God Movement Storm 1602 at the edge of Troll lands. We could go up from here with Trolls, or they can give us a map to continue. We head for the surface. The area is snap cold - visible breath. We don our warm skins. We have two weeks of trail rations, three pigs, and still have our barbarian to carry stuff.

 

[days with the trolls were checkmark clearing opportunity]
Rockwood Mountains look impassible but supposedly there is a pass. If we were Esst of here we'd already be past the Rockwood Mountains, past where Torath Keen Eye has ever been before. High Worms Pass more dangerous to traverse (Very narrow w snow avalanches. Lots of ice and really long drop.) than Giants's Pass maybe a week to the SE. We have two weeks of food and three wild boars. Longer safer route divides into high country and low country. We go High (Storm Season = mud slides)
Ground completely saturated by rains so we slog through 2" mud.

 

Day One: muddy slogging. Early evening. Dig a pit, slaughter pig (two remaining). Roast. Graves specials the cooking roll. 3 watches 2 per.

 

Day Two (Water Illusion Storm): Sun up there behind the clouds somewhere. Drizzle>Rain> Downpour. Hearty meals.
Mel spots a potential mudslide and we avoid it.


Day Three (Clay Illusion Storm): More rain. Bipedal cloven hoofed creatures scouted us last night and went back to report. Double time for daylight, moving where we can over rocky/more strategic ground, and then find a rise at dusk, camp, and prepare to defend. First third of day find successful confounding ground and change direction a bit. 1 mile visibility, lightning strike, see silhouette broo on a hill behind us WSW 3/4 mile. Torath and Graves set traps. Hear branch groan. See flying person w legs of a grasshopper? Xbow multi and regular bow speed dart. All hit but only xbow 1in10 hits LArm. Gr DispMgc1. Befud as creature leaps to another tree. Careens to side and hits tree. Falls. We close. Shoot it until almost dead and move away.
Hear Praxian cursing far behind when they hit our traps.

 

Moving on. Throough rain/storm occasionally hear branch breaking as they get closer. Look for advantageous position. Driving rain.

{{+Hilltop Battle|closed}}

 

Graves' right arm swells up and takes another 5 points of damage and sells with puss. Mel contracts whooping cough. Torkal takes another 5 in his abdomen w yellowish puss. Healing 6 matrix - abdomen. Peri First Aid gets Gr 3 points back in his R arm (now 1). Gr Healing 1 - R arm now 2. Phasia takes Det Life matrix and Enhances it - can feel life but has no feeling of nonliving things. The hauling of ass lasts the rest of the day. At rough spots we change directions and look for defensible terrain. Stopping to lay traps. Night: Mel and Graves 1st watch. 2nd watch Peri & Torath detect movement, wake Tarkal. SpotHid (sabretooth bear meandering toward pigs) and DetEnem (no). Peri disrupts. Trth wakes us for combat. Gr & Mel crank xbows. Trth binds and we begin shooting. Continue until dead. Trth takes rest of the night to prep bear while Peri keeps watch. Everybody else sleeps.


By mid day 100% travel begins to crater Torath. Rain has subsided a bit so the camera could pan back after the dramatic battle and show us the wilderness. Watches Ml/Gr Pe/Ta Ph/Tr. Day passes. One day until done w pig meat, two live pigs, working on bear meat. It will be three days around. Next day Gr awakes w +1 str siz armor -1 dex. Apply -5% to everything.


End of two more days back in Praxian desert.

Phasia dream: sitting at fire w Praxian Barbarians (Bison). Warrior there who died/avenged/spirit. Music in background. Smoky air. "Come to warn you - something very wrong w condor shaman. Be very careful."

 

WATER TRUTH STORM arrive at Hidden Green, where mirages stay long enough to be caught and give benefit (Oroginal Sun rising after great darkness, delayed by the mountains, slows time here so you can catch up to the mirages before they disappear.), is a valley leading to Giant Pass. A tribe of Sable Riders is here to stop at the water hole.  Mel gives Condor Shaman (!) his Great Sword  in trade for healing everybody's broo derived maladies. We notice the ratio of men to women is weird (10 men to 80 women and children, only 40 sables). Allegedly, the shaman has managed a ritual such that the oasis doesn't disappear, which is unprecedented. Found Child cult has no shrine here. There are none, which is wrong. Also no mobile totems other than condor head and spiritual symbols. Told by warriors that big party away shrine (special bow) with them to use in a fight.

 

Torath creates game for children under 11. Overy hesitant when usually more vigorous. Normally, adult men don't play w kids but nobody seems to care. After a brief time the women begin to mindlessly treat Peri and Phasia like Praxian women. Tarkal casts DetEnemy - result negative. Gr DetLife seems all good. Has time stopped here? Phasia joins with women who treat her not as foreign. She picks something super simple, makes casual conversation and pumps them for info about shaman. Cooking w ingredients with no resemblance to anything in this oasis.  They've been here about a season. Torath flirts w girls of appropriate age who act normally. Comotion: horrible accident w tusker mauling other tusker's leg. We must now wait while they heal it over days...Torath suggests we make camp and stay a few days. They offer to throw a banquet. We boogie w/o pig and they don't come after us. Night sleep nicely as far as possible. In the morning our broo wounds have returned.

 

One more day through Hidden Green and we are at Giant's Pass. Road not horrible. Pig can make it. Peri and Torath find the path through (making climb roles). Day Two Peri and Graves succeed again. Burning through rations now. Day Three Peri and Graves succeed again. Enormous mountainous castle in the distance - two more days of success. SACRED TIME Winding up lonely path on Malia's Day. Base of trail meant for Giant to have room, if it existed in real world it would collapse but must be major magic because not. Trading any of the Nine Giants (Mountain Ranges) is training with Ganorta. Two days up the winding road to the castle designed for giants to live. HUGE. Smallish Giant next to door (size 50). "Success in all your endeavors." Laughs at Graves.

"I trade for Ganorta." Cranks the door and invites us in. Awesome place. Giant sized table and chair and also one our size. He removes the stone as Graves requests in exchange for then posessing it. Graves will return to normal over time. Phasia offers god's blood crystal that deprives her of a sense in exchange for amplification. The Giant shows a compass. When you afix it to something you have owned in the past it will locate items paired/attuned/created from your soul. It cannot find a ring lost in the previous (2nd) age used to build walls of Pavis and then Citadel West of here. Last seen w hero Balazar (human hero from West). Want it back - valued over anything. 3-4' golden loop. Three places in the world it could be destroyed - not near here. The Ring of the Giants. Hidden from us using magics at the time of the building of Pavis by those from islands from SW (Jresteli). Three times the ring was used to the west of here during this year to build the citadel of Elkoi. Compass attunes to one target until it is found. If the search is impossible it will not attune. Peri brings out power enhancement crystal to trade. Iron Rock Bow takes too much strength to pull. Twice Shot Bow 2 base mana hits a second time for sure (no strike ranks and not battle magic or countermagic possible) traded for Graves' Yelmalian Sunlight Amulet + Tarkal's 9pt god's blood crystal.

 

Graves may drink Rock Beer for three more weeks (before it will kill him) and be healed of all wounds/maladies including the point loss from the troll-friend bite. He will reduce a bit each Wild Day.

cards.name: RQ 20110326
cards.content:
{{+date}}

[[Don McClure|Don]], [[Lisa WilliamsCraig|Peri]], [[Joanie Albee-Good|Phasia]], [[Joe Good|Mel]], [[Brandon WilliamsCraig|Graves]], and [[Tim Schlaak|Tarkal]]

 

Freezeday Disorder week of Sea Season (first day of the new year) 1603

We remain in Giant country. Graves drinks Rock Beer. We are in Ganorta's Castle in giant country close to Dikene on the eastern edge of Balazar.

Four weeks of meaningless travel back to Pavis. Newtlings. Weather. Epic landscapes. Panoramas. Don't ask for check marks or you will die.

 

Freeze Stasis Sea 1603

PAVIS is not burning and the food situation has stabillized. Head home and greet Artos The House Boy.

Mel to Chalana Arroy to get treatment for Broo cut cough. Healed. Con point back. Must do temple duty for a week.

Graves reports to Elejan, has tea, and offers assistance whenever required over the next two weeks.

Phasia goes to Elejan and shows the compass, and offers to work for a week. Will ask Graves to take shifts as well for a free week of training. Check mark on Bargain (success up to 30%). Learn Pelorian. Make sure slaves don't steal, back up his evaluations.

 

On shift w Phasia, she finds Elejan's face is pale white w sack on table. Someone just "handed him his death" Looks like a piece of bronze encrusted w god's blood crystals. Looks like a sliver of bone from dinosaur.

RE Issaries during time of darkness: Lightbr went w Chalana Arroy and others to bring light back to Glorantha. Iss was torn apart by Hyena god w chaos. As priests when presentedw a piece of our god we are duty bound to take it to the waste to return it to other bits of god reforming there. Phasia proposes that we will accompany him for company.

 

Graves' next shift he asks for more information. Deliverer was Sartarite but unknown. Magic in a bag he wanted to sel for 10 silver pennies but too scared to look in bag. Graves presents evidence that the party may be the target and gets us fired from going into the wastes. Phasia asks about Council business and gets appointed to sit in while he is gone. Debate ensues. He will send for his cousin in Nochet City to come and take over.

 

Tarkal takes Pelorian class at Issaries temple (Elejan's ) w Phasia and Graves and buys a Bladesharp 2 matrix. Then learns Spirit Binding.

Elejan El Nadir walks into Humakt temple w huge-ass sword on his back and a bag in his hand. Asks to see Rune Priest who is training people in broadsword. Mel takes over the training. Elejan gives the bag to be put in the Humakti vault and hires the whole place (except Mel) to go to The Wastes for double pay. Mel goes to chat w Graves and Phasia, at which point there is a strategy brainstorm about what machinations may be in progress.

Elejan realizes that a council vote coming up is the likely target of this maneuver.

 

Four council members are not too motivated by money: Polis Protector, Greybeard, Isthar the Maul, and Elejan

Kost came to Elejan today and mentioned the journey (not widely known) and insisted on going with. Will put his wife on the council, who is more money motivated. (Genert may be the broken god but an Issaries priest must still respond)

Because the Council Members pay so much more in taxes, last month there was a vote to get more money from council members and so was installed a rider -- a statute that provides that, if there is a windfall in a given year, then the council memebrs will gain the right to be reimbursed and make a profit. A bribe to the city of over .5 million silver could make a percentage end up in the pockets of the council. DRR is also not so money oriented but he only breaks ties anyway. Ingilly has his salt lick back and things are looking up. Elejan believes that whoever paid off the Sable riders to break their pact with Ingili withdrew their directive.

The current Pavis Council is: Polis Protector, Greybeard, Isthar the Maul, Elejan El Nadir, Indigus, Ingilly, Orlanthi brothers, Aleya of Chalana Arroy, Newly Installed Yelmalian, and Duke Raus of Roan to break ties.

 

Elejan responds to Phasia and Graves' entreaties and asks the party to go to the head of the Brightgrain family in Yelmalian area. Ask him to return and take Elejan's seat permanently. He will sponsor bringing the Brightgrain family back.Give Graves a sealed scroll in response to the question about the money Brightgrain gave the party and return thereof. "I'll take care of it."

 

Graves and Tarkal go to see Greybeard. Black stone on table w bucket of Rubble Runners, vat of acid, cage off to the side. Takes a pole, grabs RR by neck to move to stone, evokes same, magic happens. Stone found in rubble (and then bought from Elejan) was core of a primal chaos temple which will give a chaotic feature to anything. Asks Graves to dwell on "when is a spear not a spear?" Has ordered from Nochet City several books which reveal info about where in Empire the Magicians did their work. Hardest part will be to find out about Dragon NEwt that died or place it died. Naturally paired with what would be required to open it. Barbarians took the magical stuff and did not value other bits. Rubble Runner has turned grey and was about to turn the soul into the disease spirit, so he dropped it in the acid. Has killed a hundred or so so far. Stone both chaos and disorerder, therefore uncontrollable even to original priests.

 

God Movement Sea 1603

10L/wk/person for two weeks rations. Graves covers Phasia. We replenish arrows, etc. for 2L ea.

McCleary visit. Patsy IV impales the designated target with the crossbow and is approved of. Heading downstream. Turns out Captain Bly is available once again. 240L (40 ea for the 5 of us + Patsy) for passage.

Boat fights happening just outside no longer occur. Trip is seriously uneventful w unremarkable battles (no checkmarks).

Wind Illusion Sea 1603

Reach crappy dock around noon. Bly heads downriver. We head up crappy little road. Sun is beating down on Crappy Little Town. Militia assembles - 6 guys. Crappy Beadle/Constable bugs us before telling us to head up the road three days past two villages. Next village one day's walk away. Camp. Patsy makes tollerable Mu Shu Sable in a plum sauce. Watches: Mel/Patsy, Graves/Tarkal, Phasia/Peri. Two guards arrive to refrain from fining us 10L for sleeping on the road and move us along to the next village. Lots of cops. No crime. Walnut Crrek. The Brightgrains "lead the Beadles of this county". Four hours later at village - close to Daybreak. Fire Illusion Sea 1603 Patsy makes us breakfast. Mel chats w soldiers to find out any more necessary customs over their breakfast beer. Moving down the road. Pass carts. Roads don't make sense (gooved strangely) until we see Yelmalian carts which are more narrowly gauged. Pass three patrols of two soldiers each. Encounterless area. God Illusion Sea 1603 arrive at grain/trade village/hub nicer than all others. Dutiful activity in streets. Get directions to middle class rural home. Use knocker. Slightly older of the sons opens the door. We are warmly welcomed and beered. A more sturdy Ingilly Brightgrain arrives in farming clothes. He asks for news. They have had good rains and expect a good harvest. Mom returns. We dine.

 

We make our/Elejan's offer and hear of the regional problems which he feels unequal to solving. Perhaps he is not the

The problem pre-dates his arrival. This area is not known for being the richest part of Sun County. Used to be the northern edge borderland of SC but now there are some north. A priestess, Guemata, in town is not Yelmalian but native. A distrurbing divination by Guemata lead to an increase in patrols did not lead to tracking down the evil/chaos. Ledger for village (translating from fire Speech). During High Holy Season Guemata saw a village infested by The Devil - monsters roamed the streets and the evil that walks through the night was the master of the town. A survey of villages reveals no issues. The newer villages to the north are probably less governed but the problem is not obvious. A few raids by Praxians toward the north closest to Waste are not unusual. Earth goddess Eiretha, wife of Yelm, leads to local feminine representative to balance a strong male priesthood like Yelm's.

He will happily return to Pavis if the problem here can be resolved. Eight days to solve the mystery until heading back to the dock. Given nice rooms for the night.

Freeze Truth Sea 1603

Visit Guemata. Vision: village (known from the life happening there but not specific) from one of the women villagers pov.  All walked about with filthy sticks protruding from their stomachs at various angles. Creature walking at night could jump between the rays of the sun. Felt a vengeance and evil. A presence felt, real not seen, always at the corner of the eye. Very raw emotions - not normal like a person. Streets had monsters running about - the idea and not specific - separate from and terrorizing the villagers. Divination was just part of the usual ritual of the winter grain. In dream the ritual appeared as well, usually involves a priestess but felt like a villager, but the grain tasted sour.

Is there a village that has lost its priestess and is lead spiritually by a lower ranking woman? Don't travel.

How many villages are in this county? Sixteen, incuding High Cliff. Four to five immediately surround. Outskirt = 11.

We introduce the Compass and ask for her silence about it, beyond her lawful bond to speak if asked by IBrightgrain.

Magic compass spins as she concentrates. 15-20sec the needle lands in a direction. She says it points ENE toward three villages to which the roads are not direct. It is now locked to the person who invoked it and to the purpose to which it has been locked.

Two days indirectly to _____ and then one each to _______ and ________. She would go with us if with Brightgrain.

Ask Brightgrain to approve next move. Swears us in (deputizes). Gives Graves a ritual spear, a map, and a writ of permission.

Water Truth Sea 1603

Walk a day to next town. Arriving in evening w Yelmalian militia and priestess. New reading the moment the priestess touches it. Triangulation reduces it to one or two villages. Bed down for the night.

Clay Truth Sea 1603

Bid Guemata and militia goodbye and walk all day to smaller (60 people & 18 buildings) village named Dry Well. Scraggly farm land. Greeted by Beadle and eight man militia. Dirty freaking Orlanthi coming through looking for work for the last year, village well went dry (used to be Sweet Well) two years ago, Hazia smugglers. East there are cliff toads. Cliffside protects us from barbarians. Well down to bucket height - about 40ft. Mel casts Det Mgc (we light up) and Det Enemies. Tarkal casts light on pebble and drops. All normal. Stays visible even under water a bit.  Shaman normally goes between villages but hasn't been around for two years. Just stopped coming. 

Stay in house of Beadle for the evening. Mel checks w Beadle for permissions about being on roof. Each two on watch will carry Det Life Mtx and patrol outside.

Older village (Young couples don't come back). Catch folks going to outhouse. Folks are up later than is usual. Graves casts invisibility and provokes a goat to butt the door open in a nearby house and slips in while the man is putting the goat away. The old couple sits and talks in fire speech. Graves opens the door and sneaks out before the two minutes elapse.

Wind Truth Sea 1603

Walk to next town - Black Rock. Six man militia and Feathel, the Beadle, who is a bit hardier than the last. Asked for our papers. Well fine. Earth priestess, Tayola, is here. Series of shrines to earth gods and small hut nearby. Wake up old priestess who opines "Sleep, sleep, sweet nearness of death." Tarkal knows about her tatooed tears - worships Taya Kora Tek (gave and blessed burials). The Giant seer mentioned that the ring is in the womb of Taya Kora Tek. Tarkal lets Beadle know we will be patroling and we bed down. Sheshnelan discussion about his discoveries. Usual watch shifts taken outside.

Fire Truth Sea 1603

Morning w livelier village w kids etc. Tarkal drops light rock down well. Kid watching. Asking him questions. Local area - closest East facing caves - farm land. Village right on the edge of what didn't used to be but is now Yelmalian.

 

Back to talk to Tayola. She meanders about death while Tarkal philosophizes thereon. Graves wanders off to pee behind her shack, goes invisible, and return inside to search. Finds nada. Goes back outside. Pees and rejoins the group. Tarkal asks for a divination to help us find death. Feathel says even seed grain was confiscated from villages from North to go to feed Pavisians for great profit, and many people died of famine. Tayola comes back to say that "this village has been VERY blessed by the goddess." Feathel agrees to take responsibility/blame if she is the problem and lets us know that she goes frequently to the graveyard on a hill on the way to the caves.

 

Dismiss Feathel with a promise to keep him apprised. Graves wanders toward the graveyard and the others follow. Mel distracts the tag-along kids with stories about weapons. 15 min walk to graveyard. 2 purposeful hours further to the hills (w no road). Well tended cemetery w no disturbed graves. There have been no burials in last season. 40 graves all marked w names on stones.

 

Little girl bugs Tarkal, notices line of hidden bone dagger, constantly asks "why?"

 

Peri sees 3/4 mile away a woman walking in the hills looking down at us. Graves tracks the woman's steps in and out but to one newer (less than 5 years old) grave in particular, marked "Artera".

G, Ph, and Pe head for the hill where the woman was visible. Phasia mind speaks w Mel and conveys plan. Get to hill, find lean-to, find young woman dressed like shaman sitting and looking up at us through veil. Graves introduces and asks to sit w "Penless". Phasia asks why she is here near the village. She serves the spirits nearby. It is a coincidence that they are near the village. The spirit Red Toad allows her influence with the cliff toads to keep this area safe. Brief interview wherein she says nothing helpful but nervously messes w her spirit rattle until Graves asks to look at it (not touch), after which she puts it down and begins obsessively scratching her hand. When Graves mentions it she send us away.

 

Mel sees these kids play rough games in which they could actually hurt each other.

 

Tayola, who worships Ty Kora Tec, is probably not an actual priestess but was an acolyte of the Earth Priestess of Eiretha, Artera, who died a couple of years ago of a disease.

 

PLAN: Night surveillance to steak-out graveyard. Farsee before approach.

Directions to 5667 McBryde Ave, Richmond, 94805 

 

From Berkeley/Albany/El Cerrito and parts south

Take 80 towards Sacramento, exit Solano Ave (not the shopping drag - Solano is two exits past McDonald and one exit before San Pablo Dam Road).  Take a left at the stop sign onto Amador (the service road) and then right on McBryde (will also be at a stop sign). 

 

 

From Sacramento and parts north of Richmond/San Pablo

Take 80 towards San Francisco, exit McBryde (one exit past San Pablo Dam Road).  Take a left at the stop sign onto McBryde and curve leftish up the hill. 

 

In either case

{{5667 McBryde|size:large;float:right}} Up near the top of the hill, at the Alvarado Area entry to Wildcat Canyon Regional Park, look on the north side of McBryde at the corner of at Marin Ave. for a peach-colored house with avacado trim and a white picket fence.  Take the path to the right of the garage around and down to the deck at the back of the house.  Our door is on the back porch facing West.
