cards.name: RQ 20110409
cards.content:
{{+date}}

[[Don McClure|Don]], [[Lisa WilliamsCraig|Peri]], [[Joanie Albee-Good|Phasia]], [[Joe Good|Mel]], [[Brandon WilliamsCraig|Graves]], and [[Tim Schlaak|Tarkal]]

 

Water Truth Sea 1603

1500h group gets a bit of alone time by kicking Feathel's family outof their house.

1700h small knock from wife of house who sends us out in order to prepare dinner.

Feathel The Beedle wants more info and to participate in whatever will happen.

Dinner happens. His seving ear is comparatively nice.

Night surveillance to stake-out Tayola's stone house. Phasia Farsees Graves. Tarkal and Graves take first watch on opposite sides. The temple is right next door. The graveyard is a twenty minute walk away.

 

2125h Tayola exits her house and heads for the graveyard. Graves follows as Tarkal returns to get the group.

Peri and  Phasia head directly overland, through fields, to the graveyard and make it at the same time as Tayola. She walks over toward Artera's grave, kneels down and is doing something. Graves crits his move and hides to get 20' and see a knife and ritual markings, chanting, wiping away ritual markings. Graves checks in w Phasia and core dumps. Tayola mourns/prays/keens softly and continues, finishes, puts knife away, heads back.

Peri comes into grave area. Joined by Graves who calls in Phasia. Light cast on rock to see grave area. Diagrams created in 2' diameter circle. Blood mixed in w dirt and dry full sized human finger bone. Graves picks up finger bone. No obvious result. We leave the grave alone (but Graves palms the finger bone) and return to the village. Feathel is in fill armor and waiting with the militia (all 8 guys), wanting news. Phasia asks where we can get info on Ty Kora Tec. Beyond Goodwell there is another village (two days each way) with an Earth Priestess who can answer our questions. TKT is one of the three sisters (oldest of the Earth Goddesses) responsible for helping (beyond the soul's peace and correct destination) survivers and family members adjust.

 

Hut to hut search begins, on reaching Tayola's hut they find a body hung upside down, insides spooned out, not recent but not super old. Stew on the stove.

Beedle Feathel recognizes that the upside down Yelmalian body is not from this village. Graves flanks path on which Tayola will return and watches as guards coe=me and take her away.

 

Someone of modest size is walking from the direction of the village toward the center of the graveyard. Kid. Send him home. Party comes. Twenty minutes of digging before a light arrow arcs up from the town and we book it. Clanging of weapons and screaming. Less screaming. When we come into sight we see blood everywhere. Feathel alive but armor gashed and ugly wound. Phasia heals Feathel. Tayola turned into taloned nastiness and began laying about until the fully armed and awake militia who had had her bound could beat her down.

 

Patsy, Graves, and Peri go to finish the grave. Mel, Phasia, and Tarkal stay in town. Dig up body, which looks unremarkable, and move it to edge of graveyard wrapped in a tarp. Leave diggings for later and go home to grab some shut-eye. Village celebrating the action. Watch on duty all the rest of the night, guarding burning corpse, etc. Party keeps single watches and night passes uneventfully.

 

Two days of travel

Wind Truth Sea 1603

By night have returned to Queen's Cliff. Speaking to priestess, Guemata, re our quick return. When she touches the compass it points right back to whence we came. A village with only one religious is not usually seen to by a TKT. Mel guards the High Earth Priestess who will now come with us, bringing two acolytes.

 

God Truth Sea 1603

Back at Black Rock. All well. No troubles since. They had burned the body and "soup." Brought in the Toad Shaman who liked the feel much better.

Take Guemata to graveyard and describe everything again.

Negotiating the need for more investigation with Feathel. Compass in Guemata's hand points out of town.

Mel and Tarkal escort Guemata to Tayola's shack

Mel is in full protect the priestess Humakti mode and senses that the the three guards are about to kill

All kids and soldiers are about to kill Ph Pe and Gr

Varlath, son of Feathel, calls out to kill us quickly and move on to support others attacking priestess. Continues giving orders from "Mistress".

Feathel and Thozal Strongspear only two adults attacking who are truly competent.

Phasia befuddles Thozel. Kids all disrupt Graves w three successes. Attractive naked woman manifests behind the line and unbefuddles Thozel. She is Succubus spiritlike but sexual and malicious. Peri perforates her right leg. Series of darkwalls while we withdraw into the midst of three huts to begin sniping. Gr invis Ph who throws up Lightwall around Gr & Pe. Bads heal and regroup.

 

Succ appears to runemgc Tap Power Mel and sucks 2d6max POW. Instructs flunkies to befud Mel, now at 2 POW (will rise 1/wk)

Gr/Pe both invis flank run back toward Mel/Trk/Guemata. Ph Mobility flanks the other side, gets to Mel/Trk and reports as they finish off their guys (one of whom tries to surrender to Mel after disrupting him, only to be skewered by Tarkal).

Ph invis rem 5; Pe invis rem 6; Gr invis rem 7

Guemata can help w mgc on area (Warding 2 which takes time to cast) when we make a stand.

cards.name: Earth House Center contract BW+tracking+Daily+20110412-0418+working dinner at Cafe Tibet+Associations
RQ 20110430
cards.content:
{{+date}}

[[Don McClure|Don]], [[Lisa WilliamsCraig|Peri]], [[Joanie Albee-Good|Phasia]], [[Joe Good|Mel]], [[Brandon WilliamsCraig|Graves]], [[Tim Schlaak|Tarkal]], and [[Ted Greer|Ted as Patsy IV and then Torath again]]

 

Ph invis rem 5; Pe invis rem 6; Gr invis rem 7. Guemata can help w mgc on area (Warding 2 which takes time to cast) when we make a stand.

 

Water Truth Sea 1603 cont'd

Mel takes group into nearby hut. Find cowering woman. Ph asks for a 411. Woman blithers about Mistress. Gr/Pe head for PatsyIV's sniping roost. Mel asks Guemata to pray for a Divine Intervention and everyone in the room gets Earth fecundity throug their feet and are restored entirely (all POW, all Runemagice, magic points for all people in the hut). Graves give Boom Potion to Patsy to throw and Gr/Pe circle Patsy's shack. Mel turns ankle and falls while shooting - can't run away. Patsy hurls boom-potion into mid shield column and hits. Big boom. Lots of smoke. Kids have come through thatch to jump from above on PatsyIV, now visible Peri, and invisible Graves. PatsyIV misses w XBow. Peri perforates three kids. Mel is in the doorway with Phasia and gets impaled in the head by Feathal. Phasia grandstands marvelously. Tarkal misses but paries. Yelmalian tries glue and burns a point (Mel's head is organic) with no effect. Gr switches to Brdsw misses and is missed. Pe switches to Brdsw and misses, the kid hits but Pe paries and damages his spear. Tarkal gets impaled in the abdomen for 8.

RULE AGREEMENT: Honoring 01 as crit impale. Anything else is as roled.

Phasia grabs Mel's head and pulls it off the spear. Guemata heals Mel.  At the Kids' table everyone jostles and paries. Mel back up. Ph casts Crush2 on QStaff. Graves gets 2 through to his 9. Feathel crits Mel, who paries. Ph crit crushes Feathel and removes his left leg. Pe slashes leg off kid. PatsyIII grapples kid's head into wall. Mel gets impaled in the right arm (17 of which 1 pt gets through). Kid impales PatsyIV. Graves carves him terminally, pulls out spear, and heals PatsyIV for 2. Through the window, Tarkal gets impaled in the head and killed. Mel steps back to remove spear from his arm. Phasia holds the door. Pe and Gr switch to bows and fire once. Gr does one pt. Mel breaks Thozal's spear. Mel impaled again in right arm for 1. Gr drinks MultiMis4, then Det Life on rank12, and holds to fire Xbow on 1 of next round into Mistress (impale and three hits). She drops, turns into a pool of water, and sinks into the ground. Gr tripple whacks and drops one. Pe does likewise. Guy coming into building from window. Mel calls withdrawl and send priestess to archers through window. Remaining spearmen enter room and attack Ph/Mel. Priestess heals PatsyIV. Ph casts lightwall and goes through window. Gr re-cast Prot2 on himself. Mel dives thr window and Gr Ph each get one shot thr the window. Gr hits. Pe impale. Don declares victory. We clean up.

 

Grab Tarkal's body, and question blubbering woman. Succubus appeared in town and began ritual torture of men and children. Any of the men would have killed anybody who didn't help continue the status quo. 28 women in the village. She sobbingly points in a direction as did the compass in the hands of Guemata, saying "The Drying Barn". We send her to gather the other women and go to get help from the nearest village. Guemata says the will of the goddess is to push on with whatever combat is required at whatever price must be paid. We recover the acolytes who were being pursued by the kids. Go to Drying Barn.PatsyIV caries Tarkal and all his gear. Twenty minute walk out of village to Drying Barn.

 

Single willow tree. Mel Det Magic in tree and small pool of water - both. Priestess goes to assess and performs Bless Earth. Spirit combat w Succubus and destroys it. Barn has: on posts many pegs have traveling gear (quick getaway), drying Hazia (Yelmalian illicit drug) in huge bales. Carvings of strange symbols on columns. Things were living here but are not here now. Tracking: kids in and out, some living here. Adult tracks lead out to hazia fields hidden between grain rows. Mel Det Mgc in barn: find nine bags each portions of skin, hair, testicle, different bits from different people.

 

Around are are trees more accustomed to dry heat. Willow indicated sympathetic magic keeping it alive. Guemata suggests the only way to discover more is to dig. PatsyIV grabs shovel and digs where pool was until he finds girl's body (under 20 and over 14years) thrown here in a hole and covered. One bracelet with a name in Fire Speech "Visla". Take her to graveyard and bury her. Guemata blesses the grave.

 

Return to quetion the woman. Visla is the name of all females children in this village. There was a Visla who disappeared. Feathel used to like her. We head to search Feathel's house to search. Graves searches 01 - four hidden caches totalling 160 wheels and ritual dagger used to carve people. Used to be Yelmalian officer's dagger. Bad luck carvings in the rafters. Lock of hair. Search house of Tayola. Find records of births and deaths. Earth Preistess would read for better part of a day (written to be hard to read) to get the gist.

 

The women won't stay while we go to get Tarkal resurrected . All 28 get food for three days to travel with us (5 are too old but the others are all pregnant).

 

We make it back to Brightgrain. Suprised that we took priestess. Tarkal resurrected. We take 100wheels and give the 60 to the temple and village women. Brightgrain would prefer to be lenient but Yelmalio would have them all impaled. Rushed court case to decide in few days before he is replaced. The women are spared but will be watched.

 

Birth and death records: about the time the current Beedle's father died and his son became head, there were a series of deaths (Earth Priestess on day of Winter Grain Ceremony) that stripped the town of most of the healthy men and older kids. Twelve years wherein things went from bad to worse. Skyrocketting birth and death rates. 9 men in the village and 20 births a year.

 

Into the town, 3-4 days after judgement, a high priest and several Rune Lords arrive and visit w Brighgrain for two hours. Brief/momentary eclipse is felt. HPr walks out and Two Runelords walk out and announce new governor. Brighgrain is packing - he will leave his Yelmalian armor and spear here. His judgment will stand. Dry/Good Well will be sent help. Excommunicated - now just a weapons thane. We will travel together back to Pavis. His kids are adopted by relatives to stay in cult until they are 18 and can make their own decisions.

 

Clay Disorder Fire 1603

Head back to Pavis. By Fire Day at the port. Wait two days for a boat. Roll on checks. Two days boat ride back to Pavis.

 

Torath Keen-Eye awaits us. There are whole new Orlanthi adventurering bands and the Ruins are the Big Thing again. Our legend from living in the Rubble for many weeks (we were actually with the Trolls) makes us the Great Masters of the Rubble in Pavis. Phasia to Troll Market, takes staff, asks to get matrix recharged. They want some trading in town done by her to get better deals for trolls against which people are predjudiced. Three days spent haggling - mostly for weapons.

 

In town we have three reputations: 1) So good we come back with new clothing. 2) Movers and shakers if we were hurt the Council would crush. 3) Troll-firends, therefore we fight like Trolls and give no quarter.

 

Graves and Phasia go to visit Elejan, give tea, and announce having brought his replacement. A dinner is given in our honor. We lounge and Artos constantly tries to clean everything.

 

2 weeks of training, etc.:

Torath travels to a temple to sacrifice pow for rune magic - hunt ritual

Phasia and Graves go through Issaries ritual to gain Shield Spell through fair exchange of 2 pts power each.

Torath gets asked what he knows about The Compass while in a bar talking to a babe. A guy joined them, third beer casts a spell on Torath, who invented a story about a compass that gets one laid. Scored. Came back and related story. We vote to tell him about our actual compass.

Graves studies at Lankar Mai for both weeks to learn Spirit Binding and third point of MultiMis - now 3.

William is of age and going through that awkward stage.

Phasia attunes Compass to mace and it points WxNW. Mel buys a riding bison. We doubt the wisdom of traveling across the Long Dry to the west in the midst of Fire Season.

 

Go visit Gimpy to ask for any news from the West. A device was found that appeared to mint gold coins every day, but after a bit they disappeared. Giant urn in which a giant salamander was found. Temple of Pavis may have things which may be incomplete or very valuable later. Phasia hooks Artos up with an account with Gimpy. Graves pays 50sp for the season Artos has already been eating here.

Pay trainer to work w William on War Goat skills while we are gone at 20sp/wk (5 wheels now and the rest on our return).

Northern Route west by way of the Pairing Stone to Adari - 2 weeks to Jaldon's point (almost edge of Sartar)

 

Wind Fertility Fire 1603

Mel complains about PatsyIV being too smart. He kills him right there, as it is intollerable to fail to please. The next one must also be able to cook. All others buy bisons at 152L + 20L for leg armor. Food for 3wks = 15L. Head into Rubble through Troll Gate, letting slip that we are going for 8-10 week trip into Rubble to get something big. Trolls will be happy to let us hang with one of their caravans. Three day trip with 1 in 20 chance of a major attack. A few minor skirmishes but no big deal. During the day Graves and Torath set traps and hunt.

 

God Fertility Fire 1603

Arrive at First Through The Breach Troll Clan area. The will re-take control of the Breach from the Tree Breaker Clan in order for them to give us clear passage. Phasia picks up her recharged quarterstaff. Two days of prep, brief Torath (focus on Dark Trolls and trollkin - avoid the Great Trolls). Trolls explain: clan guarding the breach. We will sneak into area for ritual fight. Those who can't sneak deserve to be attakced. Kill trollkin, offer quarter to trolls, try to sneak into ritual area. The others may perceive you as Trollkin, at which point they may kill you. Particularly dangerous but we are known to be warriors. Two approaches: directly at the defender and make it a bit farther. Between two is better but will fight more and have less chance of making it to the end. All split up and take each challenge as we can - all going at the same time.

 

Gr heads between two Trollkin and fails hiding, fights both. Cast bladesharp2x2 and he misses. Kill a in 1, parry b, Dark Troll coming. Gr befuddles the Dark Troll and parries the Trollkin. Parrying. Demolish b. Cast Invis and Silence to pass through second level to Ritual Area.

Tor heads for one troll and succeeds. Listens. Casts "draw beast" Rubble Runners on jerky and throws it away in order to go around in 2 rnds. Sneaks around on third round to third level. Seen and moving jumping mobility spell, pursued into ritual center and almost grabbed - they give him a beer.

Pe heads between two trollkin and is seen/heard. Kills both in one shot each. Sneaks on unsucessfully and jumped by Dark Troll.  Befuds him and walks on into center.

Mel challenges his Dark Troll in full plate outright. He casts bludgeon and waits for Mel to cast Prot4. Back and forth. Back and forth. Back and forth.  Back and forth. Fumbles and is taken out entirely, offered quarter, accepted, taken to "didn't make it" area in center.

Phasia heads directly at a Dark Troll, making an attempt to be covert. He let's her whack first and then fumbles multiple times: shield explodes, helmet falls off, wide open for auto hit and she 7s him in the leg and he invites her to pass. Ambushed by Dark Troll at melee range. Phasia casts Silence and he is surprised and then hit. Hits him in the ten for thirteen. Heads into third round and ambushed by Great Troll. Attack and parry. He crushes her, heals her from dying to offer her quarter.

Tarkal heads between a Troll and Trollkin and alerts them indirectly. Makes it into second section stealthily. Passes through successfully into Ritual Center, shocking the trolls therein.

 

First Through the Breach Clan did much better in getting to the center for the final battle of all who remain. Torath paints on wode and jumps in while everybody else watches. Fights well until needing to yield, but our group wins and the other clan packs up and leaves nicely. Invited to stay for a couple of weeks and help with day watch while Phasia heals. Checkmarks. Training. By the end she has 2 pts in her abdomen. Gr trains up on shield parry and Dark Tongue

 

Clay Illusion Fire 1603

Ready to go and down to one week of rations.

cards.name: RQ 20110514
cards.content:
{{+date}}

[[Don McClure|Don]], [[Lisa WilliamsCraig|Peri]], [[Joanie Albee-Good|Phasia]], [[Joe Good|Mel]], [[Brandon WilliamsCraig|Graves]], and [[Tim Schlaak|Tarkal]]

 

Clay Illusion Fire 1603

We notice the Trolls charge other people a toll to pass the breach. Ready to go and down to one week of rations.

 

EXPERIMENTAL HOUSE RULE: party travels 140km, minus 20km per week per checkmark earned (max of 3). Missile Weapon, Set/Disarm trap, Weapon, Mapmaking, or healing-up.

 

Travel plan: Follow river into 10k dist from mountains, then follow hills from Pairing Stones to Adari to Jaldon's Point. We go more slowly in order to get two checkmarks each or heal up. On the way to the Pairing Stones (plains of Prax between river and hills) we see in the distance dirt being kicked up as someone comes in our direction. Phasia farsees Mel who can't see through the cloud. Three min away and moving at speed of slowly galloping horse. Three rounds of arrow fire before it gets here. Our bisons at full rate can match it but not leave it behind.

T-5 Mel prot 4 mtx

T-4 Pe prot 4 mtx. Mel and Ph send away bison. Gr fails to direct his bison away.

T-3 Ta prot 4 mtx. Ph Befud (targetting works, spell didn't work - soul not overcome).

T-2 Ph prot 4 mtx. Gr invis. Ta fires into the cloud

T-1 Gr prot 4 mtx and flanks full movement

R-1 three swirling dust creatures attack a bison, Ph, and Mel. Mel nukes his w brdsw. Gr blows his invis by disrupting for 1. Peri's Bison gets 7pts of its hide removed (1pt armor everywhere) and then hit in the head. Dead.

R-2 Gr fires xbow and it grinds up the bolt. Ta disr3. Pe brdsw kills hers. Mel 06s Ph's w max damage. END Dust Devils

Five person weeks of food from cooking the flayed bison for rations. Checkmarks for Gr and Pe.

 

Uneventful week to Pairing Stones.

 

Gods Illusion Fire 1603

Ten groups of ten + small leadership group. Fully armored horse cavalry troop(banner with a Black Stallion)  in residence - Sheshnelan, lances, crossbows, barding, wagons, handlers in the desert in the summer. Otherwise empty. They've just arrived and set up tents, tending wounded. 30-40 of 300 Sable Riders died in a pitched battle and are running away. Gr notices partially articulated like Shesh, but bronze, but missing sorcerer and squires entirely. Not dissimilar from Duke Rous of Roan.

 

Ph farsees Gr who succeeds Hide In Cover to watch entry and ready mindspeech. Ph recognizes their tradetalk has signif Esrolian accent. There is a small competition as the men get a chair and drink for now the only woman in the camp. Gr attempting to sense any oddness/magicality in the group. Preserved strawberries offered. Bellow in Esrolian "Where the *9&&.$% are My Men?!" from the center of camp. Completely dressed in full iron field plate. Sir Ethelrest. They have been attacked every day since leaving Jaldon's Point. Mercenaries headed for Pavis - already hired by Elejan El Nadir. She asks for a token and shows her Gennert. He has none. Black Horse troupe, "the greatest mercenaries in Glorantha." All mercs have heavy xbow, bastard sword, lance. Phasia is satisfied and whistles the party in. All but Graves enter. Turns out the Lunars are doing very well and would confiscate any large weapons and serious armor we might take. Pimper's Block might have merchants who will charge too much to hold our gear for as many seasons as we hire. Weapons training in the afternoon/evening. Ethelrest figts better than should be possible for a human but has no rune markings. Welcome to join in, stand a watch, etc. Good camp discipline all round. May very well be the best mercs anywhere. From the same part of Esrolia invaded by Sheshnellans and then went native but with colonial aspirations remaining. Armor imported from Loskalm north of Sheshnela.

 

Freeze Truth Fire 1603

Three days meet zero barbarian tribes. Instead find sites of battles, the attacking hordes reducing in size and getting more tentative at each point. Stopping at mixed but primarily Yelmalian Adari. Take compass bearing = WNW (Gr and Pe map skill) toward Castle of Lead (only passable by north via Dagori Inkarth). Re-supply. General "things happened while you traveled" resupply is half a quiver. Mel spots Graves to three weeks rations. Adari mainly prepared for troll attacks from Northwest. Last cupply point prior to Torch (elven stronghold in troll lands). Gr has no money now, so sells info for 2 silver. Mel buys 150L peppers and 50L of black and red ink to trade to the trolls later. Rolling on checkmarks.

 

Five days to gates of Castle of Lead with no encounters. Gain two checkmarks.

 

Water Disorder Earth 1603

Mel pays 50L in peppers for us to be allowed in Castle of Lead. Compass has changed dramatically and now points SSW to Jaldon's Point. We hang out, as there are no public houses. At evening people get up, shops open, and people begin their worknight. Argan Argar trading houses. Ph selling to merchant offering food items - 140L raised to 200L. Mel gives 50 profit to Ph, keeps 50, and give Gr 100L because he is broke. Mel goes looking and finds a greatsword among the things taken from foes - buys it for 200L.

 

Head for Jaldon's Point. Travel eight of nine days (two checkmarks) to Jaldon's Point without running into anything weird and check the compass. It points due North, back to the Castle of Lead. Aaarrggh. Head south to finish journey and get something to trade to go back North and gain entry.

 

Wind Harmony Earth 1603

Jaldon's Point (expanding, Sartarites live here, at leasst 400 people, Praxian, Sartarite, Trade talk, Pelorian). See 25 Lunar soldiers (despicable group) + 1 priest collecting Orlanthi rebels hiding in the hills to take them as slaves. Buy 1000L of lead with which to load bison and also food. Return to Castle of Lead.

 

God Death Earth 1603

Arrive. Pay 75L of lead to enter with 925L of lead remaining. 2pm. Compass points SW and we begin following it as it changes directions street by street to entrance to above- and under-ground residential area - home of unfamiliar clan. We knock. Female answers and hears Phasia tell of our interest. We wait for three hours. She returns and offers us the cover of their (Kargartar Clan) darkness, takes us around the ritual three times, hits a cagelike box which cries out at being hit, and the Mace is touched on the second time around. We ask for its story. The Matron wants to know why Some Human would try to get trolls to fight Worse Than Death. Phasia explains what we know of the Thanatar. The Matron pulls out Spavi from the box (been in there for two weeks) and asks for his story. Phasia asks for him to go back in the box and rolls out the history of his wrongs. Mel asks 1) to question him in her presence 2) to keep him in the box and 3) consider allowing us to buy or offer a service in return for the paired mace.

 

He is our messenger from Sartar. The Thanatar is the hero quest to prep (by killing the head on the belt of the person we should have killed) for becoming the Chosen Ones to kill the Lunar Crimson Bat. Dude. WTD probably still hiding in more civilized area (Yelmalian area or Pavis) looking for the heads of Greybeard and Polis Protector's heads. Spavi will now be known as Bobart. We must take him with us or he'll be killed and not be able to "help" us. To get the mace, Phasia must fight and risk the staff. The winner will take both.

cards.name: RQ 20110604
cards.content:
{{+date}}

[[Don McClure|Don]], [[Lisa WilliamsCraig|Peri]], [[Joanie Albee-Good|Phasia]], [[Joe Good|Mel]], [[Brandon WilliamsCraig|Graves]], and [[Tim Schlaak|Tarkal]] [[Ted Greer|Ted as Torath]] (Death of Mel)

 

from last time...

God Death Earth 1603

Arrive. Pay 75L of lead to enter with 925L of lead remaining. 2pm. Compass points SW and we begin following it as it changes directions street by street to entrance to above- and under-ground residential area - home of unfamiliar clan. We knock. Female answers and hears Phasia tell of our interest. We wait for three hours. She returns and offers us the cover of their (Kargartar Clan) darkness, takes us around the ritual three times, hits a cagelike box which cries out at being hit, and the Mace is touched on the second time around. We ask for its story. The Matron wants to know why Some Human would try to get trolls to fight Worse Than Death. Phasia explains what we know of the Thanatar. The Matron pulls out Spavi from the box (been in there for two weeks) and asks for his story. Phasia asks for him to go back in the box and rolls out the history of his wrongs. Mel asks 1) to question him in her presence 2) to keep him in the box and 3) consider allowing us to buy or offer a service in return for the paired mace. He is our messenger from Sartar. The Thanatar is the hero quest to prep (by killing the head on the belt of the person we should have killed) for becoming the Chosen Ones to kill the Lunar Crimson Bat. Dude. WTD probably still hiding in more civilized area (Yelmalian area or Pavis) looking for the heads of Greybeard and Polis Protector's heads. Spavi will now be known as Bobart. We must take him with us or he'll be killed and not be able to "help" us. To get the mace, Phasia must fight and risk the staff. The winner will take both.

 

This time...

Phasia agrees to duel at midnight. Hospitality extended. Scrumptuous troll meal. Make con checks. Midnight.

Freeze Fertility Earth 1603

Trollkin whacking decides extent of battle. Phasia crits and chooses to disable a limb. Twenty or thirty rounds of give and take - about a five minute fight in which Phasia takes a couple of mighty hits (and only uses one of her Birthday Game re-rolls) and then diables his arm to win. Mace has couple of runes which together create: halve the cost of bludgeon spells up to the sixth level. Two uses of Dark Walk (15 min version of invisibility which stays on). One use of blindness. All get used up however mace and quarter staff together and atuned allow 1 pt of rune magic can be refreshed by overnight prayer, as if Rune Priest in temple. Mace slightly more ornamental. Qstaff more sturdy.

 

The trolls bring Bobart's box to the edge of the city, pull him out in manacles, throw him at us, he hits his head and is knocked unconscious (6 pts to the head). Phasia heals four points. Mel tosses him over the back of his bison and we head for Pavis.

 

Bobart is healed (Phasia 6) and Graves plays flute until Mel transfers him to Graves' bison and rides at a distance. Two checkmarks a week travel plan (100/wk - lose 20km per) but (new addition) no XPbonus on non-roleplayed (not dangerous) combat. First evening watches: Peri and Mel, Tarkal and Graves, Torath and Phasia. Bobart sits up on watch two and casts 4 befuddle spells and an extension on Torkal. Bobart is really Tesserson (bastard son of former King Tesser of Sartar) advisor to King ____ who just got gacked. Tesserson warned of Lunar victory and got ignored, and of Boldhome getting sacked, ignored. Everybody who wanted us to complete the three tasks and defeat the Chaos Bat is now dead. Sage dude may or may not have made it out alive. Graves is invited to become a Eurmal entire, as he "could be the greatest Eurmal of all time." Graves buys in. Tesserson assigns an initiation and offers some special Eurmal skills: meet an Issaries and engage in a negotiation for someting he actually wants to sell so annoying (out of frustration and anger) that I am excommunicated without violating actual Issaries practice. He whispers in Graves' ear and confers 5% + Oratory bonus 15% in Confound.

Everybody awakes and sees that Bobart has departed with six days of one person's food and water. No questions asked. Day of travel. Day two - storm on horizon much bigger than the dust before. Veers our direction. Four minutes lead time. T-7 Gr mindspeaks Torath: "Don't look directly at Wokbath" (fighting Stormbull in Godtime) in Eternal Battle. Gr Shield 2, Prot 4mtx, Invis. We all roll against Pow 15 to survive the dust storm (and then dex times 3 to avoid damage) to get into Godtime and into battle with plate armored walktopi. Gr and Mel, Tor & Ph, Pe and Trkl

Mel is killed by a stroke to the head. Graves takes Prot 4 mtx, Spirit Shield -2 mtx, and 6 and 4 storage crystals. A nearby guy is throwing stars at the opposition and then, dying, says to Tarkal "Don't forget me. I am Sankhor."Gr sees a way through the battle to dessert on the far side, and checks his Int to see the way through the fighting, grabs the rope attached to Tor and Ph, and begins running for the breach. We get out, though Peri almost gets stuck. All check marks are auto-succeed. Hereafter: Torath can endow arrow with Sure Shot matrix. Peri hitting walktapus = cannot regenerate. Tarkal grabbed scroll from Sankhor. Graves special ability attached to tracking: Find The Path (use skill for things not traditionally pathfinderish -- through a busy street, for instance)

 

The sombre trip to Pavis is uneventful as the group mourns Mel.

Wild Stasis Earth 1603

We enter through the Troll Gate. Kog Ito Ergosum of First Through The Breach Clan, str 17, size 28, and natural intelligence of 7, wearing bronze chain, heavy mace and maul, darkness and man runes i.e. Kigor Litor. Appears that we were in Rubble for a season and a half. Things have camled down wuite a bit and we go through the usual schtick (requests for donations, etc). Head for temple of Humakt to report Mel's demise. Huge wake in Mel's honor, but boring/ stodgy. All go to see Treya who swears never again to date humakti and takes the rest of the day off to mourn. Graves racks his brain for an Issaries Elejan doesn't like in order to annoy them horribly, and remembers a potion salesman who did not help when things were bad in the city. Artos freaks at our new troll companion, who doesn't look like he'll fit inside. We show him the stuff he can't touch or die (William), touch and get thrown out (Artos), etc. He camps in the back yard. Pe sends Artos to get 5L worth of food for Kog, 10L of steaks and wine, and 5L for Artos w instructions not to treat Kog unkindly. Tarkal goes to tell McCleary who screams and drops into weeping sobs.

 

At a private dinner, Graves tells the party about Tesserson and confesses to his Eurmally leanings. Phasia and Torath tell heroic stories of Mel.

 

Tarkal goes w Kog to negotiate armor repair, hides a bit unsuccessfully, Kog wants to know how we got  through the trolls, they go drinking at Gimpy's,hear the story of losing his leg to Gorp-flingers. Tarkal tells about Mel, admits that we've ad contact from our Sartar messenger, letting out that the guy who destabilized Pavis is still alive. Gimpy starts a betting pool on how long "the guy who screwed us over" (Bobart/ Tesserson) will live. Various people start trying to fix it and asking questions of Tarkal abot last sighting, etc.

 

Peri visits Bob the Butcher, who wanted us to go after the Butcher Block lost in the rubble. Whatever animal is on it and cut correctly, the next day, the person attuned may reproduce the animal for a fresh slaugher. 5ft long, 2ft wide, 6in thick, made of solid stone. Waha markings all over and detects as magic. Is there anything in town used with it? Original 3000L offer will be honored. Nomad breached through south wall and made it as far as place Trolls and Elves fight, about a half a mile from Ogre Island to East. Counter-attack lead by General of the time who lived 15-20 blocks east of Puzzle Canal (great Godlearner mysteries - can enter Hero Plane, like Eternal Battle but kinder gentler). Probably took it back there. Then city taken by trolls who had no use for it. 1-2 years before city devolved into factions and tribes.

 

Phasia works in Elejan's shop for his brother from Esrolia, in exchange for Tradetalk lessons. Torath shows Kost's runner to learn where and how they go to gather information about what's up in the Rubble. Graves reclaims William from his war goat training. He will now stand and fight. This might not be good. Kog goes to find a cookie. Graves hires an urchin  to spy on Potion Guy. End of week. People come in to buy crap 1-2x/hr and others come in to buy good stuff twice a week.

 

Next week: Torath explores rubble - Kost gives him his own route Zebra Gate to SE.

Freeze Illusion Earth 1603

Graves takes Kog (pretending to be supplying a Troll caravan with potions) and goes to make Potion Guy miserable. Succeeding, he gets a Confound checkmark, has all Issaries identity stripped, and becomes an initiate of Eurmal.

 

Peri goes to Meet Kost and buy him a drink and ask about the ruins east of Puzzle Canal. High danger and low return. Runner passing yesterday saw nothing. 10 silver. Take Troll route East (veer off from the closest they get to Unicorn Riders) and approach from there to minimize danger. Or, if Walktapi and other nasties from the Puzzle Canal are eaten for breakfast, take boat down River and get off 20 blocks east of Puzzle Canal. Whatever we are looking for better have been in a basement. Raised to the ground.

 

Peri tells everyone of what has been learned from Bob the Butcher and Kost the Barbarian.

 

Phasia paid 5gp for helping Elejan's business while working in the shop. Bob (Bison Burgers) knows that clan chief of Bison Tribe claims knife used by his great great Grandfather. Currently SE of Rubble nearby. We met and partied with him.

 

Tarkal, Graves, and Kog visit Greybeard. Experiment: trollkin can eat anything. So can gorp. If Trollkin eats a gorp, which stomach wins? Eurmals can swallow anything. Hmmm. Greybeard strokes Graves' eggs (time to travel) and discusses Sankhor with Tarkal. Cursory divination for two gold. Two hours later comes back and then disappears again. Four hours later comes back looking frazzled. Description requested. One hell of a fight. Style of dress and method of fighting different. During Time of Harmony celenstial court filled w thousands of gods, most of whom died leaving war gods and their followers. Gods died and were lost to memory. Tarkal brings out scroll he was able to retrieve. Greybeard opens and runs his hand over it. Asks permission to open it - some kind of magical exchange happens. Golden letters happen. He looks it over and "understands completely." Sankhor was the God of Invention. One does not exist now. The scroll gave a chance to understand everything about the god for a moment. Letters glow one last time - catch a flash of who the god was. Invented all manner of useful stuff including harp, instruments, brought useful things into the world. Invented a way to track things that did not exist yet - there was no time but he found a way to measure sequence. The Mostali (dwarves) learned much from him. The Jresteli would have loved this god for his inventiveness but had nothing like him. Asks troll to step outside. Speaks of things in the world to which straight-laced people might object. Books from the original city make it possible to remember a god. It is possible. Also possible to creatively misremember a god. Their consciousness has become the world around us. Lankhar Mai only knows what his worshipers and libraries know. Gods can be influenced by the collective. 50 more silver changes hands in exchange for tis information. To be a priest you must choose the mastery skills and then preach it as fact and always so. Everything that happened in God Time actually happenes prior to now. Access depends on being on a Hero Quest. Inside the Lunar Empire, the City of Glamor might know more. Also (we would not be allowed in but) City of Ten Thousand Mages. Library in Old Pavis can be harvested (12 wheels each most ever paid). Library is on the South side of the River, due south of Ogre Island. Biggest threat - too close to old mint, which is highly prized, and not too far from Devil's Playground (broo, ogres, barbarians, rubble runners, and library guardians - animated statues and magical traps).

 

Phasia buys bastard sword for 75L as gift to Bison Chief. 15L/person for 3wks rat. We go. Three days.

Freeze Illusion Earth 1603

There is a big feast.

Made brothers/sisters of Buffalo Tribe and they will move the tribe as close as possible toward the breach. Lines drawn on our faces. Sacrifice. Torath and Kog not included.

 

 

 

 

 

Thanks for the updates, Joe :-)

  --[[Brandon WilliamsCraig]].....Wed Jun 22 22:50:55 -0700 2011

cards.name: RQ 20110618
cards.content:
{{+date}}

[[Don McClure|Don]], [[Lisa WilliamsCraig|Peri]], [[Joanie Albee-Good|Phasia]], [[Joe Good|Cog]], [[Brandon WilliamsCraig|Graves]], and [[Tim Schlaak|Tarkal]], Brendan as Crazy, Ryan as Hobo/Barbarian

 

Freeze Truth Earth 1603

There is a big feast.

Made brothers/sisters of Buffalo Tribe and they will move the tribe as close as possible toward the breach. Lines drawn on our faces. Sacrifice. Torath and Cog not included.

 

Friends of the Bison Tribe Dinner. Grappling contests. Cog and Graves (special) both nicely successful. Phasia and Peri only women allowed at table with warriors.
FYI 1/2mile North wall of rubble
Graves tells the story of the Condor Shaman Sable Tribe to the collection of shaman there. Turns out Grave is a predator in his heart but listens to the desert rat who survives the day.  No one should "stay too long at Hidden Green because knowing one's place in the time and the world is of paramount importance." The night passes and in the morning there are a certain amount of headaches. Cog stays up the night until Phasia awakes. Tarkal is approached by an elder with kid translator in tow. Wants to marry Peri and Phaisa to one of his nephews.

 

Language of Sankhor scroll was understood magically and we don't know what it was. A young man who look slike the chief reports to us. Two Shots is the sun of the chief and severn warriors are happy to come with to recover the Block in a journey frought with danger. Cog has a plan. He will be hauled into the rubble on the two wheeled cart to see if the ride is smooth - and will guard us by night. An elder is assigned to begin teaching us Praxian for today. Dinner is another heavy meal. Tarkal shadowed by pretty tribal girl who serves him and tries to fix his shirt. He promises it before leaving the next morning. The Chief approaches Phasia who suggests her and Peri's role should be that of shield-brother warriors and not marriageable. Phasia would be open minded if there were an equally open minded Barbarian dude. Peri thinks someone not able to approach directly is a eunuch.

Clay Truth Earth 1603
Next day on the road. We rise early but they have been up since before dawn. RE the whiteboard map we begin from a point at about 5:00 in the SE part of the wall, needing to pass between Yelmalians and Elves. We change our plans and stay one more day so we may travel by night. Maiden brings him a quiver with 20 arrows and he accepts. She fletched the arrows and their actually quite good.
Night One. Squashing Rubble Runners = check marks. Daytime find basement become a sharp four-sided depression. Good rolls and some sagebrush means camo success. Graves casts invis and Phasia farsees him to go scout. Nada.
Night Two. Cog thinks recent group of 4-5 human individuals headed E>W on foot. May have had a troll or trollkin. Graves concurs. Phasia farsees Cog to scan direction of tracks. He sees dim lights (lanterns bouncing off something). Everyone makes excellent hide/move rolls, excpet Phasia not so silent. Five humans with a bound First Through The Breach troll and trollkin.
Cog Prot4 and Bludgeon4 and arcs in. Our arrows rain down. Cog Jumps through the air over tha bad guys and lands on the back guy.
Graves loots the bodies: adventuring loot bags. Chain armor and 1pt leather. Bronze broadswords, shields, secondary spear or bow. Cash total 43L. Two healing 2 potions (small clay pots). 3 power crystals unattuned (Phasia evaluates 2 each as as 2 and 1 as a 4 - Cog gets a 2, Tarkal gets the 4). 1 mobility matrix with a minor flaw. Graves takes the mtx. Peri dibs next power crystal. Phasia frees the Troll and Trollkin (Brendan and Ryan) and we give them their gear back. Graves keeps the L and the broadswords will go to the tribe. We'll try to sell the chain to a Troll caravan. "Crazy" the Troll will hang on to the healing 2 potions.

 

Continue with Crazy and trollkin. Dawn breaks. Camo successes in part of a building. Night Three. Compass slowly pointing more and more to the west (almost more west than north) and we are stilll south of the river. Exact place we slept camoflaged the first time (giant snake and Ogres). Two hours travel to river w cart. Cog and Phaisa will watch at the top of the rope. Graves, Tarkal, and Peri will swim for treasure. Three campfires on our side of the river. Tarkal sees that part of a human are being cooked over the fire. At least twenty individuals. Graves
scouts the camp and finds Broo with two plate covered leaders (probably rune lords). We run away to complete our quest and swim for treasure later. Down the river to a place with no guard coverage. Graves swims ropes across, helps Peri swim the cart across using the ropes, swims for treasure twice w no result. All across safely.

Cog leads on. Run into Great Maul Clan troll patrol.  Insults exchanged. Push on through day and night to First Through the Breach area. Cog reports. Praxians invited to sit at warrior's table as Cog was, despite the vast diffferences. Phasia explains what they must do to the Buffalo Riders. Dinner results in a certain amount of puking. The Bufflo riders.

Wild Truth Earth 1603
Sleep the next day away. Night: Grumbling among the Buffalo Riders. Phasia addresses the issue. Turns out there is only one way to hunt/ride/live and this is not it. The argument continues. Sleep the day. Cog speaks with Argan-Argar and his carvan is ready to leave within the hour. He will get the two suits of chain and we will leave the caravan half way through. Travel the night. Sleep day. Night travel. Compass (carryied by Peri) is pointing due south. Puzzle Canal is visible at half mile. Peri sees half of a candle worth of light behind a series of reasonably large bit of rubble (area has some second floor - most complete rubble on this side of the river). Graves scouts ahead. Twig snap bu tnot attacked. Adventure pack glowing with magical light. Open bag of salt. Detect trap success. Withdraw to cover nearby. Disp Mgc twice and remove light. Second time meets resistance and doesn't succeed. Det Traps spell reveals the remaining trap on the salt and bag as well as two more at the edges of the 40meter detection area. Feel and shake off effect that attempted to make me forget the existence of the traps. Return to camp. Return with group. Send Hobo the Trollkin in with a Spirit Shield 2. Fascinated by "endless money" while "insect" swarm burns off two points from every location until we rescue him and take him back to camp for Phasia to heal.


Continue 300m searching  Intact single story building in Lunar (Greek) style. Compass pointing right at it. Atrium in the middle. Open archway to enter. Tarkal makes it past the warding. Original furnishings. Writings in Old Pavic on the walls. Hobo sent in. Then everybody else. Graves fails to read the walls and so copies them for later consultation. Cog Tarkal Peri follow compass around the atrium while it continues to point to the overgrown center. Extremely detailed stone statues of surprised persons. Graves succeeds: all in Pavic letters written by someone who did not know how to speak Pavic - decorative. Too many consonants in a row, etc. Cog returns from kitchen having found no slab. Hobo goes through atrium not looking at or touching statues. D6=5  %=99 sees snakelike slither before turning to stone. Cog casts counter-chaos (Kiger-liter rune magic) and walks in to do 19 points of damage on the first hit. It is smushed.

Tarkal cut his right arm somewhere (1 pt hit) and doesn't know how. Graves gets a 2 pt cut on his 5 and casts invis. Tarkal Det Enemy and they are a dozen all around. Prot4 mtx goes around Phasia, Peri, Tarkal, and back to Graves. Cog crushes one. They are drained/dead invis humaniods w needle weapons and armor. Crazy incapacitates one permanently. Phasia crushes one's head. Graves heals 2 his leg.
Two Praxians have been pricked, killing . Two Praxians ( ) spread rope and run with it to find bad guys - whereon they slice it up.
Graves feels his veins petrify (not quite to his heart) removing 10 points of con (leaving 3). Tarkal looses 5 con points. Graves collects 3 needle swords. Peri and the compass leads to circular stair in the atrium going down. Graves looks at area of fight. Something not right (Eurmal sense) broken stuff from fight has disapeared, etc. No resemblance to an area in which a huge fight just happened. Moving the compass around suggests a foot diameter space above the stairs down but that the Slab is aboveground.

Cog and Chiefson descend w rope tied to find glyphs. Graves comes to find they are not Old Pavic. Cog recognizes them as chaos speech and sees the slab being used as sacrificial altar by chaos temple. FYI Krarsht (greed and ravenous hunger) is a major chaos cult. Many minor dark/chaos cults as well. This is a minor cult: Exect (darkness and not abiding other people having things) with dominion over insects and illusion.

 


Phasia casts prot4 and Graves casts mindspeech on Cog who uses the last of his counter-chaos to stride into the chaos temple and takes 8 pts to his 18 and he drops healing 2 on it. Insects begin to form into a person. Cog Crushes it. The weapon it is forming is a reverse scimitar made of dark iron. Cog begs Kigor Liter to guide his hand but without success. Peri Prot4mtx and pass to Gr. Cog begs for healing, but no. Chiefson takes minimal damage through the ward and, making an excellent speech we can't understand, deals real damage through to the baddie. Peri bow in the stairwell 1) fire arrow hit and 2) impales but for naught. Graves preps a befuddle backed by 9 points of bound spirit magic points. Befuddle succeeds and Cog does twenty points to abdomen - kills him the first time. Baddie DIs and attacks Chiefson successfully. Peri repeats the befuddle and Cog Crushes the abdomen again. Bad DIs again and it only costs him 1pt Pow. Graves xbow hits but doesn't through, and he withdraws to prep again. Praxians all run down stairs. Massive battle insues through six successful DIs until Phasia casts blindness resulting in attack from which Bad finally doesn't come back and turns into insects. Leaves behind iron armor and dark iron scimitar.  Work on wards and destroy. Remove people and bodies and bash temple to destroy. Now upstaris is ruins like everywhere else w/o plants etc. Bedroom matress technique to get slab up stairs, onto cart. Head north while destroying chaos runes on reverse scimitar.

Go successfully to Troll Market. Phasia give Graves 5W and he goes to Chalon Arroy for Heal Body (Con). Graves gives 8W 55L and Mel's 420L. Phasia takes iron armor and reverse scimitar to Elejan's shop and bargains w his brother for 250W. In order to spend 10 days untouched (better than 5 wheels/day at Hotel Pavis) Phasia arranges two Humakti initiates for ten days for 10W to keep Graves safe at home. Chiefson comes back in two hours w Zebra tribe member who will help us through the area controlling the salt lick and surrounds. Free pass through their lands but then we must pass the Yelmalians.

Wind Disorder Dark 1603
Rolling on checkmarks etc. Graves formally studying Praxian during recovery.
Shaman must rub block w sands of Prax for a year and a day, and then animal used and discarded before slab can be used. We are beyond thanked by Bison Tribe. Chiefson earns new next name, Night Friend, and Cog is treated in a very friendly way. Chief offers free training with his people.

Fire Disorder Dark 1603
Tarkal speaks w Bison Chief (thr Translator) to tell about Chaos feature he acquired. Consultation with woman, father, and shamans. Permission to delay until Wild Harmony Dark 1603 so Graves may attend after recovering (+5% PRaxian again) and one week crash course in Praxian. Praxian wedding. Meet cooked. Dowry presented to Tarkal of nine herd bison and a riding bison. Rituals performed. Bachelor party day. Woman's Day. Games and riding two days. Marriage. Final banquet (every night as well).  Peri works w Chiefson Night Friend to turn black powder captured in battle w Dwarves to create pyrotechnic display. Tarkal's bride, Miridian, is an initiate of an earth cult and related to Chief (niece). Physically attractive and with all typical Praxian Barbarian feminie skills + healing. Picked up 1 week trade talk and pretty smart. Graves presents her with wedding gift of a 28W skilled domestic slave.

 

One more week post wedding. Graves learns Xeno Healing. Peri trades a week of training Bisonriders in broadsword for Fireblade spell.

From: Joe Good <joegood666@yahoo.com>
Date: Mon, Jun 20, 2011 at 6:01 AM
Subject: (Characters') next meeting place...
To: Joanie Albee-Good <joanieag@yahoo.com>, Tim Schlaak <ranger2@sonic.net>, Don McClure <don@digi-element.com>, Brandon <brandon@williamscraig.com>, Lisa <lisa@williamscraig.com>, Ted <teddygreer@yahoo.com>


All,
     Although you could have sworn that Cog and Crazy were with you at the wedding, it turns out it was the fermented bison milk talking; they'd actually accepted nothing more than Mobility spells with Extensions from the Bison tribe so they could hightail it back to the Kyger Litor temple in time for their high holy day.

QUESTION FOR THE GROUP: Where did the characters plan on reconvening? The troll settlement, the troll market in Pavis, or do Cog and Crazy risk life and limb trying to get from the troll market in Pavis back to the bison tribe?

QUESTION 1 FOR DON: Could two trolls without the benefit of Mobility make it around the southern edge of the rubble without assistance from daywalkers? Crazy's barely an initiate, and his stealth skills are downright awful.

     Anyway, Cog can at least have a grand old time -- he returns to the temple, tells his tale of going toe-to-to with an Exect rune lord in the heart of the Exect temple, with no one but a bison rider by his side. And he's got the iron scars to prove it -- his head still hasn't healed from that damn nasty cut that took him out of the fight for a couple of rounds... (He asks the Big Maul clan how they did against the non-iron clad broos, by the way...). And yeah, he's an honest troll. He'll describe how he was able to kill that bugger five or six times because the party, though heavily wounded from the fight with the wraiths, kept distracting the rune lord with spells to leave him wide open to crushing blows, and the insane bravery (if almost complete inefficacy) of the other bison riders in charging through the Ward when their leader went down.

QUESTION 2 FOR DON: Can a Xiola Umbar priestess heal that head wound? It was nothing special; just 10 points in the head (thanks, you damned iron-wielding piece of whatnot!). But it'll take weeks to heal naturally.

By the way, there's one speech (in Tradetalk) Cog would make to you before he runs off to the troll settlement:

"If you would, I would bring this troll Crazy with me. He shames my clan, my village, and my people by his very existence. He is a coward with the soul of a trollkin, and his family and his trainers have failed him. I would teach him what it is to be troll, to crush his enemies with no quarter and to expect none in return. He is a disgrace, and I would rather have him with me where I can train him myself, rather than shaming my clan by skulking about the village. If he will not be troll, I will teach him to be a proper trollkin."

Joe

a

 

 

Forgot to add Brendan and Ryan to the participants list. Sorry about that...

cards.name: The Bean
cards.content:
So, the first real nickname for the kid has arisen. First I called her "Little Being", not wanting to put too much pressure on her as she forms her identity. Seemed safe in its scope and implications. Then I found her too cute to resist, at all times, and couldn't help but kiss her on the bean, requesting permission or narrating as is my custom. And then she begin to show outward signs of an animal cunning and native intelligence I couldn't help but respect. I informed her that she was "really using the ol' bean". And so, appreciating her being, having to kiss the bean, and appreciating the use thereof, she has become The Bean. Brutal but true.

 

Add: Sweet Bean

Vigna Angularis = Adzuki (azuki) beans (Japanese), red chori (Indian), and red cow peas.  Sweet and relatively easy to digest and don't take very long, comparatively, to cook. The adzuki is used in Asian cuisines in salads and even as a topping on shaved ice or ice cream, and is the second most popular bean (after soy) in Japan.

cards.name: RQ strategy notes
cards.content:
{{+Players Only|closed}}

 

Joe Good 20110627

In terms of tactics, I think everyone needs to get Spirit Shield-2, we need the biggest d**ned CounterMagic matrix Elijan(?) can get us, and those who can afford the POW loss should get Extension-1 as well.

MAGIC:
R: It is always legal to dump a ton of Battle Magic points into a spell to try to blast through any defenses (Shield, CounterMagic, Reflection, etc.). The major issues are:
- Every point of Rune Magic counts as 2 points of Battle Magic. So to get a Befuddle through a Shield-2, you would need to spend 4 points (for the Shield) + 1 point (to be 1 higher) + 1 point for the Befuddle = 6 points.
- (H) The POW you use must come from a single source. So having twenty-seven POW 4 storage crystals isn't going to do you any good. I think that's why Don gives us lots of little crystals -- it prevents abuse.
- Every extra POW point you add adds a strike rank. So a POW 6 Befuddle would go off on your DEX strike rank + 6. Dumping POW into a spell is slow, but effective.

R: Rune Magic stacks with Battle Magic. This is important to understand because you see someone with a Shield-4 and a Protection-4 so he's got 12 extra points of armor and you think, "Big deal". But the mixes are equally important: To fight Worse Than Death, we need to be protected against both spirit combat and magic spells. This is impossible using Battle Magic; CounterMagic and Spirit Shield are incompatible. But you CAN have CounterMagic-4 (Battle Magic) and Spirit Block-2 (Rune Magic) up, and you're decently protected.

R: Extension is one of the best Rune spells in the game. It sounds really pointless: "Extend a battle magic spell to 15 minutes and make it passive". But suddenly even if a spell blasts through your CounterMagic, your CounterMagic will stay up. Your Invisibility will reapply itself at the end of the round that you attack. Your Fireblade won't go out when you get hit. Use your imagination. It's REALLY nice.

R: Rune Magic doesn't mess with your combat. You can fire off half a dozen Rune spells on strike rank 1, and still attack and parry normally. 

R: Bound spirits regenerate POW on their own. This is HUGE. Not only do you have a decent POW source (10-12 points is what we can handle now) to power your spells, but you don't have to worry about recharging it in the morning. Bind spirits whenever and wherever you can. The number of bound spirits you can have at once depends on your charisma. It's only a few, but a few should be enough.


COMBAT:
R: You have two actions per round: Two attacks, an attack and a parry, or two parries. (H) I believe Don insists that you can only do 2 attacks if you have a weapon in each hand.
R: If you cast a Battle Magic spell, you may not perform an attack action that round. Since the spell counts as an action, this means that all you can do is one parry.
H: To avoid making bows completely useless, Don allows you to cast a spell on a missile weapon (Firearrow, Speedart, or Multimissile) and fire it in the same round. We had the same house rule in our old game. Otherwise, bows become useless.
H: You may only do one spelled arrow per round, even if you have enough strike ranks to cast a second spell. Peri was abusing this a couple of weeks ago. One Firearrow per round, Peri! ;-)
H: Don allows "all out" attacks. You abandon your defense and your parry to get 1.5x your normal attack, identical to the Fanatacism spell. Cog was doing this constantly against the Rune Lord, because he knew he didn't stand a chance of parrying anyway.
R: You can impale with any thrusting weapon. An impale does full weapon damage plus rolled weapon damage plus strength bonus. However, you must roll 2x your impale chance to get it back if your opponent is still mobile. (Attack % if not).
R: Impales that don't penetrate armor don't stick. (H): Unless it's funny.
O: You can slash with any bladed weapon. This does rolled weapon damage twice. So if you had a Bladesharp-4 broadsword, it would do 1d8 + 1 + 1d8 + 1 + 4 + strength bonus.
O: A slash that penetrates armor sticks. You must roll 0.5x your attack to get your weapon back. (1x if your opponent isn't mobile any more).
O: You can crush with any blunt weapon. This does weapon damage plus strength bonus plus full strength bonus. Really nasty for trolls and giants.
H: You can move up to 6 hexes per turn, but each move takes 1 SR. I label this as a house rule only because the book lists human movement as 8, so I don't know where the 6 came from...

{{+date}}

[[Don McClure|Don]], [[Lisa WilliamsCraig|Peri]], [[Joanie Albee-Good|Phasia]], [[Joe Good|Cog]], [[Brandon WilliamsCraig|Graves]], and [[Tim Schlaak|Tarkal]], [[Ted Greer|Torath]], Brendan as Crazy, Ryan as Gohan the Barbarian

 

Cog and Crazy make it around the southern edge of the rubble
Cog returns to the temple, tells his tale of going toe-to-to with an Exect rune lord in the heart of the Exect temple, with no one but a bison rider by his side.
He describes how he was able to kill that bugger five or six times because the party, though heavily wounded from the fight with the wraiths, kept distracting the rune lord with spells to leave him wide open to crushing blows, and the insane bravery (if almost complete inefficacy) of the other bison riders in charging through the Ward when their leader went down.

He also makes a speech something like

"If you would, I would bring this troll Crazy with me. He shames my clan, my village, and my people by his very existence. He is a coward with the soul of a trollkin, and his family and his trainers have failed him. I would teach him what it is to be troll, to crush his enemies with no quarter and to expect none in return. He is a disgrace, and I would rather have him with me where I can train him myself, rather than shaming my clan by skulking about the village. If he will not be troll, I will teach him to be a proper trollkin."

God Death Dark 1603
At the Bison tribe encampment. Night Friend receiving kudos. Word arrives from other Bison Tribe groups that this year there is an alliance between IMpallas and Sable. They may move to kick Bisons out of oases.

No problem two day ride back to Pavis.

Freeze Fertility Dark 1603
High Holy Day of WAHA (and Xiola Umbar) arrive New Pavis to meet Cog. Happy hanging at home. Artos' household bill at Gimpy's 2W4L. Our group treasury, hled by Graves, is now 149W16L.

Week One
Phasia goes to Elejan's brother to sacrifice 2 pow to get two points of Shield and discuss future in cult. Eval and Treasure and Trade check marks

Graves' agendae: learning Pelorian language and culture, as well as acting, learning riding from Torath, big damage weapon (permitted: Maul, Great Sword, Long Spear, Pike d12+1, Great Hammer taught in Temple of Pavis d12+2, Great Axe 2d6+2) that will work in Linar empire, Greybeard for info on three needle poison swords and learn to use (same as short sword), buy poisons and become associate alchemist (5000L or 250W donation). The alchemist is Eris (the other one than the one I pissed off) is from the Lunar Empire.

Graves visits Greybeard for info about needles. Graves learn's Pelorian from Eris' sister.

Peri goes to DukeRoR and doesn't bring anything again. Asks to become an initiate of Daka Fal as is accepted. Figurines are carved of two fave ancestors. Suggests not killing people's spirits.  Daka Fal and Humakt related. Chaos Time living and dead didn't know where they were supposed to be. humatk agreed to guard Hell. Daka Fal went through the world sorting out the living and dead. Wining and dining.
Graves' Runelord transition is totally up to his priest and the god. Any skill used in task reasonably realted to Eurmally and need for 90% in 5 skills (including weapons).

Week Two
Torath gors to Greatest Fletcher in Pavis (name: Fletch) who over the week will make him one best arrow ever made for 2W. Works as Rubble Scout and gets check marks. Arrow made from iron, bronze, and copper to be poisonous to five races. Torath embues it with Sure Shot so that it can be recharged in a temple.

Graves learns acting. Peri practices climbing. Tarkal practices riding.

Torath reports that Kost the Tracker was told by the Pavis govt to stay out of the area (.25km east of the mint NW of Main Road in Rubble) and not report murders that might have been Worse Than Death, and say huge Chaos createure might be there. Don't go.

Water Stasis Dark 1603
Three non-combatant Praxian Barbarians accompany us on the way to the First to the Breach Clan encampment. Two uneventful days of travel. The breach has been lost but was held almost an entire season. Recharge of Phasia's Quarterstaff Crush 2 and Mace Blindness (they are always welcome here for recharge). The Priestess and an assitant pray over them for two days. The Praxian non-coms will pull the cart while the trolls sleep, in return for being watched at night. Two days with the trolls.

Tarkal uses the compass and the scroll to orient toward Sankhor's remains. Spins and points WxNW. As crow flies we would run over Pairing Stones. Four days traveling while practicing for checkmarks. A large part of the Impalla Tribe is here but we are not attacked, as we are now fair game for them. There also Trolls there. Told that Bison Riders will make two stands at the Oasis at Pavis - accessible through South Breach and at Dwarf Knoll, and everyone is heading there for the fight. Looks like its going to be 2 to 1 against the Bisons. Compass point NxNW toward edge of Shadows Dance where we were pulled in to the Eternal Battle.
More travel. Compass begins to flip. We stop and dig with Graves' shovel. Repair spells to fix it when it declines. Four feet down by end of day. Det Mgc (stopped by 6' dirt) gets nothing. Trolls wake up and keep digging with Graves' tent stakes, about a foot into hard rock, knowing that there are caverns down there with unsafe things inside. By morning the hole  is 8' deep. We all spread out and search. Peri finds a cave opening. Crazy is fearful and Cog asgaragus' him, but he resists(!) and gets a POW check mark. Peri jackslaps him. Tiny cave. Cog Size 28 takes -35% to all skills. Graves promises 1L every time he obviously defies his fear, and Crazy leaps to it. We attempt After 40m of dropping curves it flattens a bit and widens enough to accomodate Cog. Big low room we mostly fill. Graves find old tracks of something nasty going throughthat wall over there. Torath finds bits of bronze tools. Crazy shield bashes wall until it breaks. Walktapus attacks through and we respond. Nasty vapor and more Wtpi behind.  Vapor drops Graves and Gohan. Crazy grabs gohan and retreats. Tarkal and Peri grab Graves to retreat. Cog and Torath hold the doorway as the rest run. Up top, turns out Graves 01% a DI and was brought back to life by Eurmal (who also save Gohan but gives him a squeek when he walks).  He was pretending to get everybody out. The walktapi will be coming out one per combat turn and we set up to shoot proverbial fish in the cavelike barrel. 13 die in the first 13 rounds, before chaos feature armor keeps the alive longer. Wtps dies and becomes very stinky. Torath drops from the stench and Graves steps into his spot. Fast forward...
When 25 wtpi are done and Peri's fireblades are done, and we need to kill at least 5 more, Torath is back in the firsr rank and graves has shifted to short bow.
Eight minutes fight: the final pile of 40 dead walktapi, when 20-30 Impalla riders ride up and away again as quickly as possible. 11am

Cog uses his last minutes of Counter Chaos to check on gas - waist high.
The trolls will sleep in the tunnel guarded by humans. Tarkal gently goes into gas to check compass. It may
Day and night pass uneventfully.

Freeze Movement Dark 1603
Crazy goes down the hole, and finds the gas is one inch on the ground. We all go down. Spotting like mad. Tunnel winds down, doubles back, walktapi have been living down here. Find one wall where compass toggles. Spend entire day digging/mining with improvised tools before finding cone shaped vein of bronze.
Four days working away at the wall. Extract large amount of bronze before Phasia recognizes a God's Blood geode. Tarkal touches it, and all feel a void while he thinks of the return to glory of Sankhor, but can't think of any regeneration myths. Phasia likes the upbeat stories where the Lightbringers come back, Isaries came back, etc. The party is ripped from reality. In a Long House. Calssic south of Boldhome Orlanthi long house. Feels like God Time. We are both ourselves and other people. Torath is a hunter. Cog is a Troll.  Crazy is also a troll. Phasia is dressed in robes and carrying a quarterstaff. Tarkal is a bit vague. Graves seated to the left of the guy about to talk. Peri is the most herself of the group but somehow greater. Shared dream but mutual recognition.

All party members write their POW and three sentences about how they feel about Orlanth.

Many of us live here. it feels like home and this is Orlanth, droning on and on about some boastful story. Sounds like pure arogance about whose butts he is going to kick. Finally somebody stands and refers to great darkness being upn us (Orlanth slew Yelm) and friends dying. Orlanth wants to know if anyone else agrees. Tarkal/Sankhor suggests we should "create the light" and Orlanth says it must be so, calling for warriors to support the mission. We all respond as the gods we represent. Torath calls for a healer and Shalon Arroy agrees to come. Heroic montage scene in preparation for the creation of this light.

Preparation period when all may offer a piece of advice to Sankhor in character
Cog/Troll: leave room for the creatures of the dark
Torath/Hunter: fire brings light
Phasia/Issaries: light from a vriety of sources, can be strong, subtle, can harm or help,
Graves/Eurmal: bring metaphorical light of consciousness, how things work, shared with all,
Peri/moreso: don't overthink, just make some light that helps me tan faster but doesn't burn
Sankhor takes himself off to think/plan/invent. Somebody knocks on his door.
