Qualifications to teach Selected Courses* 

Must have completed 18 hours of graduate or higher level courses or be able to document extensive experience to qualify for teaching position in a field.

Given the highly competitive nature of gaining academic employment today, it seems appropriate that I provide you with with not only transcripts and relevant experience, but also a narrative that will demonstrate an understanding of the context of the academic material you wish presented to your students. Both my M.A. and Ph.D.degrees combine psychology and mythology in order to examine culture through the history and application of ideas. As a result, my experience is with hermeneutics and the literature of history, philosophy, religion, and psychology. Each of the American Public University System classes listed below falls squarely at the intersection of my upper level classwork, research, and professional experience studying the written and spoken word as narrative used to weave history, belief, and reason into culture through the dialogue between private and public life.                                                                                                                                

Rooted in a twenty-year career in professional regional theater and a lifelong pursuit of the liberal arts, my graduate studies involved repeated analysis of the texts, recurring themes, and social rituals through which culture is framed and constructed. Film and Literature (ARTH241), for instance, is one of the classes most frequently taught by those who study mythology and psychology as a combined discipline. This conjunction has the potential to refine a student’s appreciation of the history and traditions of film because seeing film as mythography surfaces archetypal influences in familiar images and communication strategies, revealing them to be both unexamined and extremely influential in both public and private life. As a result, a scholar of both myth and psychology is particularly suited to offer relevant, accessible, student-focused learning specifically geared to prepare students for service and leadership in a diverse, global society. Imagining psychology and mythology as cultural languages brings into focus the themes, techniques, and styles of persuasion that drive decision-making such that they become visible not only in cinema but also in the daily life reflected therein and influenced thereby. In this light, the making of conviction becomes visible in histories, legislation, advertising campaigns, corporate statements of mission and vision, and other narratives from which policy is woven. This kind of work is based in an ongoing study of the depth psychology that also underlies the schools of psychology being developed today. As a result, I am prepared to offer an Introduction to Psychology (PSYC101), discuss the History and Systems of Psychology (PSYC305), and provide an Independent Study (PSYC490) that explicitly voices psyche’s own language, mythology, and tracks psychological themes through the history of ideas by following the rubrics of Archetypal Psychology.

My study of the dialogue between mythology and psychology began in childhood but came to fruition in an undergraduate and graduate-level immersion in the history of literature and the literature of history with a special concentration on the way ancient philosophies shape contemporary imagination, thought, practice, and popular culture. As a result, I hope for the opportunity to teach World Civilization before 1650 (HIST111), Ancient Greece (HIST301), Ancient Rome (HIST302), History and Popular Culture (HIST557), Cultural History of Technology (HIST585), History of Religion (HIST588), and American Popular Culture (SOCI220). As building an understanding of history requires a focus on epistemologies, my philosophical study is well matched with an Introduction to Philosophy (PHIL101) and Ancient Western Philosophy (PHIL302). It is also ideal preparation for discussing the conceptual overlap of God and World (PHIL410) in the context of Modern & Post-Modern Philosophy (PHIL416). 

Usage of the term “myth” also refers to the intersection of belief and ritual expression, not only regarding the influence of sacred literature but also in the creation of religious communities and institutions. Myth and Ritual (RELS405) is a classic combination for Mythographers and an unmatched doorway for discovering the role of mythological thinking in history as well as in contemporary life. The Ph.D. that I had the pleasure of earning is the only advanced degree that I know of which combines mythological studies with depth psychology and is specifically designed for the investigation of the continued influences of classical, religious and “new” myths found in dynamic social systems, as the rituals associated with traditional belief and popular culture vie to influence the consciousness of each generation of leaders.

The faculty of Pacifica Graduate Institute who guided my preparation for academic teaching are well known for their contributions not only to psychological inquiry and philosophical hermeneutics but also to religious studies. The approaches of religious studies to exegesis and cultural study are as central to my experience as are the techniques associated with the study of literature. I am a member of the Pacific Coast Theological Society at the Graduate Theological Union, and it has been my great privilege to work with Huston Smith for several years now (letter of recommendation available). I would look forward to the opportunity to do as he has done and share with my students an Introduction to the Study of Religion (RELS101), Introduction to World Religions (RELS201), an orientation to Religion in America (RELS202), or an Introduction to the Old Testament (RELS211), Introduction to the New Testament (RELS212), and Introduction to the Bible (RELS311).

Brought up a protestant, I responded by studying Catholic theology with fascination during my Jesuit secondary school education, and then again through my undergraduate liberal arts degree at the University of Dallas. Even had I not had the opportunity to travel widely in Europe while studying in Rome, it was in part my study of Catholicism and the Modern World (RELS314) that set the stage for the realization that I am a religious scholar. Given that my professional and academic preparation realizes a lifelong fascination with religious ideas, music, art, politics, apology and critique I am qualified to lead academic inquiry into Religious Existentialism (RELS411), Religious Fundamentalism (RELS412), The Teachings of Jesus (RELS422), Celtic Christianity (RELS480), and Religious Cults (RELS452).

The most significant through-line in my educational history, from cradle to terminal degree, has been a love and study of literature. Folklore (LITR341) is a course central to the study of mythology in context and in depth. A much wider survey of World Literature through the Renaissance (LITR201), seems an ideal opportunity to introduce undergraduates to the vital importance of genre and the archetypal nature of the themes which bridge cultures and make both literature and the humanities in general such an obviously essential study. Medieval European Literature (LITR405) is a fascination of mine as well, as it follows the growth in cultural complexity that makes chivalric romance, fabliaux, and satire not only possible but necessary, especially as complexity continues to increase and psyche is even more in need of conscious care. Tracking the thought of Chaucer, Dante, Boccaccio and Sir Thomas Malory opens a window on fantasies of the self on which contemporary identities are still often founded. The Legends of King Arthur (LITR328) house the same images which are the building blocks of the Modern Epic Fantasy (LITR340) and Science Fiction and Fantasy (LITR240) which underlie multi-million dollar cinematic and aeronautic enterprise, as well as the theater that takes place in political life.

After years of experience in the regional theater, I have special interest in Readings in Classical Drama (LITR250) and in Modern Drama (LITR251). I truly relish asking students to see how culture and identity are, at least in part, made things, an ensemble art form in and of themselves. I would also like the opportunity to propose, as did Joseph Campbell, that traveling into and beyond the Earth’s atmosphere and looking back upon the single sphere of our shared humanity changes our consciousness. I’d like the chance to continue exploring Sacred Space (SPST629) in a way that deepens and contextualizes the reality of space travel as it profoundly effects our nation’s identity and will shape public policy for generations.

Finally, one of my primary reasons for pursuing an academic career was to address as a whole the Humanities: Research, Study and Use (HUMN500). Beginning with The Ancient World (HUMN510), with Antiquity and Medieval World (HUMN520), and questing into the Enlightenment and the Modern World (HUMN541), the history of ideas by whatever name puts contemporary complexity in a context within which it is possible to struggle meaningfully with what it is to not only be human but also to become more humane. The dilemmas attendant on Society and the World (HUMN560) which inherited The 19th Century: Romantic and Industrial Revolutions (HUMN555) require some understanding of Society, Class and Wealth (HUMN561) without which The Individual in Society (HUMN570) has little hope of making decisions wherein Individuals, Societies, and the Spirit (HUMN571) are brought into a working relationship that is truly sustainable.

I hope to serve my own vocation and the learning of others through humanistic study with an agenda in mind-- the study of the power of ideas as they become actions through creative communication. Towards that end, Public Speaking (COMM200) is a class I have taught one-on-one several times, drawing on many years of professional theater performance and a career in organizational management and consulting. Proficiency in Writing (ENGL101) and Composition and Literature (ENGL200) are courses that I would enjoy teaching as well for many of the same reasons I enjoy teaching public speaking. I find great satisfaction in mentoring those working to become more proficient in both speaking and writing well as these skills are the sine qua non of functional citizenship and cultural fluency. I wonder if the crowning skill of the educated person might be to communicate persuasively and interact with integrity in pursuit of community needs. I test the strength of this thesis through state certification as a community mediator and a professional practice as a group facilitator, aikido instructor, and conflict educator. I have pursued this art professionally since 1996 and am well prepared to teach or co-teach Dispute Resolution (HRMT411).

Combined with the lists of completed courses and professional work I have undertaken, I hope this narrative has demonstrated skills you can trust and deploy to provide your students not just with the logistics of a degree but with continuing habits of inquiry that make auto-didactic and authentic leadership possible. To conclude on a more personal note, I would truly appreciate an opportunity to work with APUS. Many of the courses you offer align directly with the research interests I have spent much of my life pursuing and, especially during this time in our nation’s economic life, there are too few chances to both serve and refine one’s thinking and teaching. I need and would be truly grateful for an opportunity to teach, and am more than happy to provide any additional materials that would make my application more competitive.

Wild Movement Dark 1603
Emerge from dreamlike sequence of being in Godtime (see PDF for mythic innovation) and no time has passed. The Sankhor geode (the size of a grapefruit) is an attunement onion - can be more deeply attuned by the same individual multiple times. Now it can cast the ambient light spell as battlemagic. A few hours of digging. Cog lets us know there is iron to be had here. Peri finds to slivers of God's Blood crystals. Torath finds bronze. After several more hours of digging More bronze is found by Cog, Crazy, and Gohan. Late afternoon. Move outside to set up camp. Torath sets out Danger Chaos rock pile signal in front of cave. From the top of the hill over the cave, Crazy sees the Impallas riding away. Graves finds and camoflages our camp, cleans gear and weapons etc. until evening. A cool breeze from Shadows Dance wafts across our camp as the Przxian sunset dazzles us. 

 

God Movement Dark 1603

Beautiful sunrise. Sleeping and digging in shifts during the day. Graves finds trove and ends up with a bag the size of an orange full of 14 God's Blood crystals. 14 weight units of bronze and 6 of iron. Phasia evaluates the GBc: 2 special. All others combined - avg valus of remaining twelve 7-800L (10,000L total). Sp1 is attuneable. Sp2 is non-attuneable and larger than others holding much but crack/flaw - 2.5 of largest healing spells. Even though they all probably came from Sankhor, these (and most) are pretty generic.

Three categories: 5 best 2 mid and 9 least

Everybody gets one from the least pile and we save the 2 mid and 5 best + 2special for Pavis and more info.

Head back toward Pavis West Gate. Minor skirmmishes. Rolling on checkmarks.

 

Water Truth Dark 1603

Arrive Pavis. No Heal Con available just now. Cog and Crazy go to Trolls to ask Xiola Umbar priestess for con heal. She finds an ancestor to heal Cog. Torath finds single Orlanthi priest in town and agrees to kill horse in exchange for Heal Con. Must convalesce for 15 days.

Back at home. Elejan is back and has devices to heal Con in an emergency. He has tea w Phasia and she tells the stories. Tarkal must be careful w those who would use him and take control over his dead body. Elejan takes back his Healing Con tea bag.

May be work for us in two weeks, when we are better. There are three deals each year which make his payroll. Negotiation happens in three weeks - dagerous - nuanced - can't go himself. Elejan looks a bit the worse for wear and slow moving.

Graves finds out that the Lunars staying at Silken Plume includes a sorcerer. He recommends going to vicinity of Lunar capital or to Veil of Flowers. Gives scimitar: "If you are ever in the Lunar empire, show this." Then he goes to continue study acting for another 300L.

 

Peri seeks out priests of Daka Fal (Newtlings, Farmers, DRR, in town Orlanthi section fall back, Trolls seriously in to it) by goingw Cog w three eating bison (taking 10g from treasury and 5g from her own $). Chk Dark Toungue and Oratory explains need for spirits. Gets a 16 and 11 with protective helping Rune Magic. Cog gets a 14pow 11int.

Elejan looks at iron and bronze and passes, suggesting weaponsmiths and armorers will pay more than his 3,850 for the lot. Phasia goes to bargain with them for 4,800L.

Gohan trains Torath in riding.

Torath finds that there are no Bison tribes close. They are in battles elsewhere. Torath grabs Gohan and Tarkal and goes to fight.

Graves learns more Pelorian from Eris' sister for 300L

 

New Pavis is in a Renaissance. More adventurers than ever before and way more deaths. Vast amounts of money being spent and groups loaded for bear and spending high money on serious training. We are still imagined as hugely wealthy and The Serious Veterans. No distinction from Gimpy who came seven-eight years before us. Phasia and Peri go hang in Gimpy's and buy drinks / tell stories. Phasia invests w Tarkal in producing sippy steins to offer at Gimpy's. There have been three generations of adventurers since we arrived. Some moved away with money. Most die.

5 best Sankhor GBCs are

7 Tarkal

6 Phasia

6 Cog

5 Peri

med are

2 Graves

2 Graves

Torath attunes the SankhorSp1 GBC: pow enhance (doubles spells up to level normally cast by humans or what you personally own) + spell storage of 15. Does not work on Heal or Xeno.

 

Visit Greybeard, random lab experiements, etc. Directs us to sub-priest. Pay 300L for three questions about flawed Sankhor GBC + 50L for certifiacte of authenticity with specs (to aid in resale and 25L off if evaluated by Elejan). 13 points held. Holder doubles chance to fumble on parry when fighting chaos. Phasia can get 2,700L on the open market or 1,350L from Elejan.

 

Clay Harmony Storm 1603

Meeting for dinner at home to exchange information. Phasia tells of Elejan assigment to come. Torath tells of the Bison Riders' need for battle assistance. They left close to a season ago and it could already be over or go for another season. We want to go help.

 

Graves and Phasia goes to find out specifics from Elejan.

 

Windsday Harmony Storm 1603

10am Tea and fruit w Elejan. There will be a secret auction (as has happened for two decades outsde the control/knowledge of Pavis) in the midst of the Rubble. We must make it to the event. Bid for items aligned with Elejan's clients. Survive to return. Half a milllion silver pennies limit for bidding. All money is pre-paid. Elejan gets location info in eleven days (God Death Storm). Two weeks later we must be there. Find out who other bidders are, if we have time. 20-30% of the items are fake - buyer beware. 20% of profit margin or flat fee to reward us if we succeed. Phasia and Graves may already be targets. Graves tells Elejan about moving away from Issaries and is forgiven. Phasia converts our silver mass into 400L ea bars of gold. Elejan will loan Mtx for Det Mgc, Gold, Silver, Gems.

 

Going to war to help the Bison Riders. Pack water for two weeks (gal/drinker/day = 2000lbs) in cart. We may look forward to lots of Far See hit and run raids by groups of 25-50.

 

Third day out, middle of day, baking sun. 40 Sable Riders begin to close from .5 mile. Into 3 groups of fifteen to ride by and pepper us w arrows. We mobility and invis the trolls who will take a rope to clothesline and then attack. Sables into two groups.

Cog and Crazy work the rope very successfully and then Cog explodes one with a crush. We eliminate several with bow fire. They retreat. 30 will come in one group with 6 hanging back. Torath casts Command Beast on leader's mount to bring him too close. Graves invis the Trolls again. We shoot. They shoot. 24 are still able to fight. They are circling us at a radius of 80ft and firing in, as Graves casts Det Life to find Cog and then cast Det Blank, at which point all Sable Riders still standing flee. We collect 3 wounded warriors and 6 Sables on which Crazy loads gear (14 outfits) from dead warriors and 7 dead sables.

 

Meet several hundred warriors and families of Bison Riders - one faction different from the usual. They invite us in based on our apprearance. Critical moment at Dwarf Knoll lead to driving major part of impalla out of the fight and Sables are slowly withdrawing, so the Bisons still hold the oasis against the odds. We present the chief a sable and he acknowledges our ownership of all we captured. Phasia explains trolls well and they are accepted. We rename ourself Larry, Terry, Harry, Merry, Sherry, and Narmoktboggle, just to help Don give us healing and check marks.

 

Torath goes into the wilderness to get animal and restore rune magic. At the end of one day of failing, he uses his rune magic to summon an animal he does not actually kill, but does ritual to regain magic.

 

Wild Harmony Storm 1603

Night: Cog and Crazy go to torment a small group of Sable Riders, observed by some of our Bison Riders. Cog Jumps in to squash a sentry and alarms those in camp. Six guys grab three torches and come for Cog and Crazy. Battle ensues as Praxians mozy in as slowly as possible and Crazy and Cog squish everybody. 7 sets of Praxian gear and sables. 2 riders survive to be prisoners. Sables added to our growing herd.

 

Next day safe travel to find our Bison group. See different gorups come by and display trophies (5 slaves 13 sables). We arrive and are treated with warm wlecome. Tarkal gives Meridian dagger bought for her, sable, and slave, and will be busy for as long as we are in camp. Large dinner group with stories shared. Turns out 60 warriors hid w/o bison in sand, waiting until impallas on top of them to leap up and kill them - strategy courtesy of Night Friend. Soon come herd and slave transfer - chief will handle our part. Peri puts the moves on Night Friend, who opts not to parry Peri. Graves begins grappling, and beats Crazy, and then looses axe throwing to Torath and Crazy, to whom he gives one of his two throwing axes.

 

Next Day: technically war time but camp pretty relaxed. Spend today and leave tomorrow, so Tarkal and Peri may continue.

Sables will be traded for bison, but we've got more sable than they have bison so they will run out. The rest can become meat. Graves will keep one riding sable and 12 will be donated to tribe to trade for whatever is needed. Also donate 4 slaves. Considered incredibly generous.

 

Head back to Pavis uneventfully and arrive Wind Death Storm 1603

Big Humakt holy day and goings on.

Phasia gives out a bit more info, while admitting to restricting access to some. We may be targets. We need to find out who else will have info when Elejan gets same?

Golden Bears Aikido Club Member
Team

cards.name: Caliban Dreams review
cards.content:
Go see the world premiere of Caliban Dreams, an original work by Clark Suprynowicz and Amanda Moody at West Edge Opera, with John Duykers originating the title role. It is miraculous that new live theater gets produced at all in this era of mechanization and economic woe. When it is made with care it is not to be missed. Beyond that,it is a fascinatingly odd production with a decade of development and many well-crafted treasures ready for discovery.

 

The Casting of Dreams

 

Caliban Dreams begins as The Tempest readies itself for endings, but the audience is not privy to Caliban, Stephano, and Trinculo being driven off stage at the end of Act Four of The Tempest upon Prospero’s order that Ariel “Go charge my goblins that they grind their joints/With dry convulsions, shorten up their sinews/With aged cramps, and more pinch-spotted make them/Than pard or cat o' mountain.” Amanda Moody’s script takes over but offers what is less a fill-in-the-blank of offstage action before Caliban’s transformed reentry in Act Five, and more an Alternate Universe ending for the Tempest as a whole. Stephano, and Trinculo simply cease to exist, and Prospero’s command that the three “be hunted soundly” is reinterpreted as all manner of torments which reel out the intestines of Caliban’s character for public viewing. The controlling characters of the Tempest never appear, except as shadows and metaphors, and then sail away before any of the discoveries of the psycho-drama within the play have a chance to get any traction in Prospero and Miranda’s narrative world. This may be a commentary on the tendency of colonial powers to do their dominant thing and then simply abandon lands and people to their own devices, but that is far from clear and the impact of greater powers’ coming and going are of little consequence in the working out of Caliban Dreams.

 

Despite the modest resources that often plague courageous premiers, Caliban Dreams is blessed with gifted stagecraft. Two levels of platforms are used to excellent effect, splitting the realities onstage into upper and lower realms, with scrims to simultaneously hide and reveal supporting cast and light effects. A ladder and a “tree” are woven to allow climbing between the two worlds, and the tree imprisons three of Ariel’s sister spirits. They chafe at this and drive Caliban to seek his own revenge on an absent Prospero so that, by breaking the Magic Staff, he will free them. A huge lunar disk dominates the sky and gives shadows a place to appear. All in all, the environment of the dreaming is believable, serves the action beautifully, and is a credit to the technical design staff and crew. One could only have wished that set designer, Chad Owens, had been afforded enough of the budget to realize the full shadow play he envisioned.

 

In the music of any theater piece, there is a natural tension between the individual melodies, which cue the audience as to character traits and the narrative sense belonging to each scene, and the musical themes that tie the individual scenes together into a single story. There might have been a bit more melodic support to help the audience find and connect with the characters through the discordant orchestral soundscape, but Suprynowicz manages tensions deftly, giving in the score both the sense of the narrative through-line of the whole story and the individual natures of the characters and vignettes. The orchestra is just fourteen members strong and often seems a world class symphony. Within the bottomless layers of sound which continually reveal stylistic homages and unexpected turns of phrase, the ongoing musical feast which truly sets this opera apart is the dense and evocative choral arrangement that underlies and makes possible the provocative performances by the renowned John Duykers (Caliban) and dazzling Laura Bohn (Ariel). The chorus of enchanted creatures is almost Greek in its force and integrated contribution to the overall coherence and sense of the piece.

 

The libretto begins in the doldrums of expositionary repetitions common to opera in general, wherein the obvious is spoken literally and then sung over and over, in English so there is no relief in the strangeness of Italian, German, or French to gild the inane. But the poetry and gravity of the language improves by leaps and bounds, offering some particularly fine dancing with the archetypal shadows from which enduring narrative has always been made as the principals struggle with what it is “To Love Thy Master” in the last scene of Act One. Likewise, in the first scene of Act Two, Ariel’s “Nothing” is almost Odyssean, given her earlier torments of the cycloptically single-minded Caliban. It is delightful too to see Shakespeare’s tropes and devices faithfully filched without hearing every line quoted chapter and verse and thereby done to death. More than once, Moody honors masters gone before by doing what they did with language, often quite well, rather than simply trotting out familiar quotes.

 

Having given credit where it is due, the ending is strained. When consciousness returns to both the drunken and the flighty it becomes clear that the powerful have sailed on about their business while the long oppressed dreamt the time away, the lessons allegedly learned seeming too foreign and abrupt. Do those bound in chains customarily wake from fantasies full of blood and fire to find themselves free without struggle or cost? I suppose it is possible but, even more than at the end of The Tempest, I was distracted from willingly suspending my disbelief by the unlikely and sudden arrival of conservative fairy sentiments more suited to the small world (after all) of Disney than the wild reality of freed spirits.

 

Why Does This Matter?

 

According to West Edge Opera’s Music Director, Jonathan Khuner’s, playbill contribution, the piece was originally called "Caliban's Dream". The transition to "Caliban Dreams" is a telling one which adds value to this work and points to an essential question that is continuously relevant: what to do with the true depth and complexity of experience? Making art is an essential response to this archetypal human dilemma, and Moody offers a helpful response in the creative evolution of her title. At first glance the dream underlying daily life may seem individual, a “myth” in the sense of imagination divorced from reality, dream as a device, a thing, far from fact and belonging to this or that Caliban. As the work unfolds into art and onto the stage the sense of it deepens into layers--meaningful cultural fictions more mythic than contrafactual. “Dreams” becomes less a thing and more an experience, a verb, and Caliban becomes more active, not past-tense but calling all conclusions into question because the Dreaming continues. Then Dreams become the focus and “Caliban” activates and particularizes the images brought before the audience. What kind of dreams? The Caliban kind in which others are powerful too and come and go. Ariel dreams, the writer, composer, and company dream, and the audience dreams with them.

 

This matters because questioning convictions and sharing imagination changes culture, potentially reinforcing a movement for which art is often responsible—from individual certainties insisted upon to rich differences valued and described, potentially leading to shared understanding and action in response to lived reality. What is at stake, particularly in live theater, is the survival of the imagination not only as a creative force but as a shared environment. What if the current Senate and House of Calibans in Washington D.C. and Sacramento were to imagine making legislation as an artful production, because America Dreams, and less a farce of certainties, revenge, and pronouncements?

cards.name: RQ 20110813
cards.content:
{{+date}}

[[Don McClure|Don]], [[Lisa WilliamsCraig|Peri]], [[Joanie Albee-Good|Phasia]], [[Joe Good|Cog]], [[Brandon WilliamsCraig|Graves]], [[Tim Schlaak|Tarkal]], [[Ted Greer|Torath]], Brendan as Crazy, and Ryan as Gohan the Barbarian

 

Wind Death Storm 1603
All in Pavis 10 days before going to find out where auction will be in Rubble.
Having dinner and discussing options:
Greybeard lessons on Thanatars
Peri to potion merchant
Week of training
Peri Climbing
Question watch about recent deaths/beheadings
Pursue spirit to bind (personal growth)

7 of 10 days: Peri and Cog go get climbing training, spending 1200L, for a week going up and down the same cliff face while reducing the amoutn of equipment used. Sheer cliff walls with limited equip, as well as evaluating fitness of rocks to hold weight. Peri is a master now. Cog not so much.

Cog to Arganargar market for 2 sets of slitted sun glasses and parasols - 60L total.

1 day: Tarkal and Graves to Greybeard, who is experimenting on Gorp. Tracking movement speeds with furry animals and different surfaces/angles. After one day of reading/conversation, we know a bunch about Thanatars. Sinister of all chaos gods. Combo of Tien (general of Wokbath-The Devil's army) was smote by Lankhar Mai and all that remained was his body. Atyar, the devourer of knowledge, is the head. Few people worship Tien or Atuar separately any more. Most are composit devotees. Consumption of knowledge. Ritual to become rune priest of Thantar - must sever ones own head and re-attach without dying. Known most for taking head sof others, shrinkging them, and wearing them to use the spirit to cast spells, knowledge to act, and divine Rune Magic as well. Also able to create skeletons, summon devouring ghosts, create darkness only they can see in, kill wtih garrotes. Gifts, garrotes, geases. Exist in highly organized structure but not cooperative. Iron rule and extreme discipline. Most valuable heads are Lankhar Mai (cannot consume mind directly but can shrink). Sorcerers are second biggest target. Any Rune Priest/Lord with unique spells or abilities. Can trust nobody thay can't immediately kill. Devour books w/o reading - know how to do things without knowing when it is appropriate. Purple light bad. Lankar Mai ritual to destroy guardian heads while in combat with it. Daka Fal - have a rune spell to fight guardian heads from a distance. Appeal to greed and laziness. Five stanza poem in six seconds: (abuse head while saying) "In the name of full knowledge I rip this tool from Thanatar to confound his presence in the scheme of being and hasten the end of chaos. Go spirit to the fate of your will." (Squash with boot) In the south (area controlled by Yelmalians) there were 30-45 Thanatari cultists operating. Individual Thanatar have been found in Pavis every other year, while those able to kill other Runelords are rare.

All week Torath researches passage of people into and out of Rubble through less obvious entries. Who comes and goes? Group of people casing entrances at the same time as him. They don't know he is watching them.
A: One group of civilized people (not Sartarites) going in with current or former employees of Kost the Tracker. In for a couple, out for a couple, getting a crash course on the Rubble. Linked to Issaries and Lankar Mai.
B: Sartarite/Orlanthi Group are experienced adventurers used to working together. Seem to be looking for work (Past Zebra stables are upper level adventureres willing to be NPC's for a cut of the treasure) one at a time but never accept. They just scope the transit.
C: Lunars - one with a second who visits occasionally.

Phasia hangs at Elejan's shop. Swamp Necromaner, Centaur, Rich Esrolians - the three potential clients for whom Phasia will be bidding. Check in evaluate treasure and trade talk. Esrolians ask for someone to go to auction and evaulate items.

Graves goes ot the watch. Bart spent 25 years in the Guard. Lost his leg in the IMpala attack of 97, arm to the Troll Riots of 94, Last year a stray sling stone in the Grain Riots cost him an eye. Yelmalian intitiate who was too ambitious. Eight years ago there was an attempt to bring group into Devil's Playgorund. All but him died and he went mad lives in a tower in Sun Dome Temple. One compatriot survived by becoming a Thanatar? For the last 8 years 2 yelmalians died a year for three years, and then many more. The first four died in Dark season each year heading to or from the Yelmalian fortress in Rubble and Sun Quarter. Another entire group destroyed five years ago. Nine bodies found headless in the four seasons last years famine. Heads: Yelmalian Priest with an acolyte, lots of Sartarites. Kost lost a couple. One musician.

Gaves returns to his Pelorian tutor for the remainder (250L) of the week.

Fire Fertility Storm 1603
Two days before finding out about auction location. Everyone reports back.
Phasia recap: Half a million L pool for bidding. Unique items and some that are cons. Elejan will provide detection matrixes.
--Delecti the Necromancer has been around for over an age and is a super powerful sorcerer who pays cash - likes anything out of the ordinary that is sorcerer and has an undead theme - anything harkens back to Empire of Worm's Friends and Jresteli (enemies but both with a presence in Prax).
-- Ironhoof the Centaur (hero) beastpeople do not have an interest in sorcery. Even godmagic not big, but natural enhancements (alchemy, astrology, mysticism, spiritual) are big. Nothing from the death of an animal. Deosn't always get along well with Sartar, so their curiosities might be welcome.
-- Richie the Esrolian wants curiosities, one of a kind, wants to spend less than the other two. Authentic artifact that other will want.

Phasia: we must decide on the pay scale (flat fee or percentage). We opt for 10% net profit + another 15% if we sell it to the buyer. No financial penalty for sales failure. Silent (and blind) paper auction. Items done one at a time.

Peri finds a Sartarite Daka Fal priest to claim Runelordship. 25pow neutral ancestor summoned 1pt battle magic and 2 of rune magic (Xeno Heal 2, 2 pts Divine Intervention Issaries, Dismiss Elemental 2), who almost eats her lunch until Cog slaps on Spirit Block. Herbal tea follows to which she adds a bit of Pelorian brandy.

Graves, Torath, and Peri go to Kost to ask who he lost to the Taker of Heads. He is not available but we chat w senior trackers. Three were lost: Near Devil's Playground a most senior tracker. An accidental lost returning from Yelornan's zone - near Zebra Gate saw strange tracks (human followed closely foot for foot inches apart by another human) and followed on a hunch. Third chased for quite a while and tracked with exceptional skill - better part of a night - killed in River of Cradles - body floated until found with divination - tried to get close to Ogre Island to put of his follower and failed. Three claim to have seen tracks and come across headless bodies - most recent two weeks ago west of Troll Break NE of Yelornans. Strange that info being given for free when Kost usually gives any that can be given. During this time of day they should be in the field. Kost is doing private tracking for a private client which he NEVER does. These guys seem nervous, on damage control duty. Nomads - nervous = quiet exterior. Graves and Peri go for a Latte while Torath stays to talk. Turns out Kost was visited by people with armor under their robes and curved swords and happily left immediately with them - seemed like old friends, instructing all of his people to discontinue tracking for two weeks.

Graves spends all his extra time hanging out by the Eurmal Shrine hoping BobArt will show up, and hires a weaponsmith to make two scimitars for his use (50% first hand 45% on the second). Buys fully trained falcon for (10g). Two weeks of rations for 8 people (8g).

God Fertility Storm 1603
Night at Elejan's tent/shop - gives matrixes and offers location dream mushroom to Phasia (only works tonight). Torath watches to make sure whe keeps the shroom. Cog stands guard in her room, Crazy outside. Dream: normal sleep, tossing turning, quickly shift to realistic market. Trading and buying.Spices being sold. peppercorn. Long ago. Graves walks up to say he just sold a pound and gives directions to site. Dream continues but with the potential for Phasia to direct it. Phasia directs dream to see if Graves goes to talk to anybody else. Approcahes an older man in red robes. Graves looks back and sees Phasia - says to go away. She goes back to stalls and listens/looks around. Patchwork of past, pulled back into ship and moved by dream currents. Wake up in the morning. Report to group. Bent Tower is used as landmark by trackers in Devil's Playground between Ogre Island and Puzzle Canal. Small Giant took a swing and bent it. Graves remembers from his dream being in the City of Glamour and trying to convince someone of everything - then noticing he is naked, etc.

Freeze Stasis Storm 1603
Will travel four days to get there. Left at 5am through the main gate. Two Orlanthi adventuring groups (total of 18 people) are pretending to brawl in order to block the gate. Torath threatens them and tells them to disperse. Cog grabs his maul and hads straight in. The seas of brawl part before him. Zebra area at typical time for adventureres to leave. Here one can hire semi-skilled adventurers. Later more skilled ones available  - fewere than normal as folks have been hired. Kost also went in with two Red Robes and picked up another couple of guys. Later two more with Lunar accents (but better belnding skills) came through following and asked questions about the ones who came before. Torath tips the guy a silver and thanks. North route we know well. Middle route is the fast road with many encounters. Torath knows a third way to the south where we once met the group of baboons (and near a Rubble Runner breeding area). We take the North route we know really well.  

Day One has minor RubRun skirmish. Find stripped remains of bison. Stealthy slow movement with doubling back to be sure. Fiind camps of varying ages (more than two weeks) one less than two days old but more than 3-4hrs. We feel we are not being followed.

Day Two forced march for distance. Tarkal hears something big coming our way. Torath climbs with active farsee and sees nothing, so we all climb until we see 30ft tall creature with Uz (troll) blood and chaos features. It sees us atop our perch and heads toward us. At 100ft we go to combat rounds. Graves XBowMM3 hits three of four and fumbles to lose right arm armor. Turns out its skin can be hurt but under that it is made entirely of a clay-like substance and can withstand piercing damage. Cog mauls/crushes it with extreme predjudice and Peri perforates. When we kill it it deflates a bit, leaving an earth elemental which opens under Crazy and, when he falls in, the gnome crushes him. We blast the gnome and rescue Crazy, heling him up. We scram. Torath thinks its from elsewhere (Lunar magic?). Torath and Graves grab a tooth from the Ogre. Torath puts him on a stick nearby with his mark to warn against the chaos here. Crazy notices that at one time he was a Great Troll of the Grakki Clan. The rest of the day is uneventful. We end near where we fought the living statue. Set traps that are set off by Rubble Runners

Day Three
We find a civilized camp less than a day old. Fight to the East along our path. Series of people look like Lunar who visited the Rubble regularly - with three others. They are fighting 5-6 other "adventurers" (probably Ogres). We move to assist. It takes 10 minutes. Graves takes point and sees circle of fire. Some people are dancing around the circle throwing into it. Graves flanks in cover and the party goes hard up the middle missile weapons blazing.  One Lunar remains as the ring of fire drops. His companions are dead. He tries to hire us to help on his mission for 2000L/day. His name is  _Teranus_ and he is a Lunar Coder (agenst working for the EMperor directly). Folliwng Epitatenus, a First (soldier in Lunar Army who is AWOL with a large amount of $ and shouldn't be in this part of the world. Must convince, capture, or kill). He is one of 64 worshipers part of the empire + 7 Mothers + Primal Chaos (1 of every 64 has 8 succcessful positive chaotic features) and is a human with remarkable abilities. cards.content:
{{+date}}

[[Don McClure|Don]], [[Lisa WilliamsCraig|Peri]], [[Joanie Albee-Good|Phasia]], [[Joe Good|Cog]], [[Brandon WilliamsCraig|Graves]], [[Tim Schlaak|Tarkal]], [[Ted Greer|Torath]], Brendan as Crazy, and Ryan as Gohan the Barbarian

 

Clay Stasis Storm 1603

(end of Day Three of our four day march to The Auction)

Re-cap

Teranus is a Lunar Coder (agenst working for the EMperor directly). Following Epitatenus, a First (soldier in Lunar Army who is AWOL with a large amount of $ and shouldn't be in this part of the world. Must convince, capture, or kill). He is one of 64 worshipers part of the empire + 7 Mothers + Primal Chaos (1 of every 64 has 8 succcessful positive chaotic features) and is a human with remarkable abilities. If we speak to him he may enforce friendship on us, has natural strength, armor, dexterity, absorb spells. Teranus sees warriors coming from the East headed NW, wearing white rags (Fate and Death Worshippers - they do a D.I. that switches fates). Graves is given the scimitars from the dead Lunars as gifts of the empire. On the way back to Pavis we will secure two yong Rubble Runners to train as attack pets for Graves and Crazy.

And then...

Teranus is now known as Actrinus. We still escort the Lunar for 2000L "as long as we are going in the same direction."

The party resumed their journey and traveled for two uneventful hours to the leaning tower where we were supposed to find the entrance to the meeting place. A quick search revealed two cave entrances within a 50' radius: One was freshly-uncovered and larger, and one was older and more decrepit. Cog went 40' into the older one, spotted no traps, and found a junction, so he came back out. A similar search of the more recent tunnel showed no traps and a junction not too far in. The party chose the older cave. At the first junction point, Torath heard movement to the left, so Cog snuck ahead and saw torchlight and heard voices. The party, not wanting to alarm other bidders by sending Cog ahead, went in the order Torath, Tarkal, Peri, Phasia, with Cog 20' behind. Torath came to a blind corner and heard Chaos speech just a few feet ahead. Peeking around the corner, he saw 4? broos waiting in ambush, who also saw him. Torath engaged the broos, with Tarkal occasionally helping with his spear. None of the other party members could help. Torath and Tarkal killed all except for one which ran away. Important note: Killed broos were using Divine Intervention to attack Torath in spirit combat after being killed. First time we've seen that. Torath now has a nasty chaotic cough. Cog and Graves went back to other junction and Graves made hiding broo "one with the wall" with Multimissile crossbow. Go to other cave mouth. Hear lute player (who is in charge?)

Approached by mask wearing shimmery dude in gold and silver robes. The auction will begin in one day's time with preview time at noon. There are people dressed in white rags. Kost is here with two other adventurers from town and his buddie (Epitatenus). There are four total exits from this cave. Auction used to be blind but now will be open. Graves watches everything: when nobody is speaking with him our host does not move. At three or four feet from him he turns toward the coming person (head first and then torso). Epitatenus has Kost get him grapes and takes full advantage of is chaotic features. Actrinus is observing and will conduct a test in about an hour. Two of the six white rags have black head bands. Graves sits by them. They seem empty (zen). "What a shame about Tentis." "you talk too much." Peri detches a tray of assorted beverages and offers to the white rags. Tentis (with a black head band) grins briefly and accepts. He was from a village south of Pavis in his past life. These guys have all been a a lot of fights, carry weapons, smell like Praxian barbarians, have been healed (perhaps a bit late) frequently. Only Graves and the two black headbands are drinking.

 

Torath casts Det Enemies. Epitatenus actively means him harm. Actrinus has an idea but needs a test subject to raise his INT and send him to get made Friendly.

 

Fight down the corridor. Nine Orlanthi bounce into the room, a couple with coughs, burns, and slashes. Andor Capaloni of the Pavis Council is in the lead. Torath mentions Epitatenus' chaos features to Graves in their hearing. They ask what the hell he meant and we leave no doubt after denying it all. There is a new tension in the room.

 

Another group (seven men looking like warriors) arrives, dressed in Southern garb from the West (Nochett City or farther), Graves steps into the "Host's" spot and he just returns ot stand by me. They speak Trade Talk w an Esrolean accent and introduce themselves around: "A pleaure to be this far East - first time to be here." Their journey was fraught w peril and their ankles have been gnawed. Danis shakes all hands. They are from Grandmother Dana (west of Nochett City, south of Sartar, famous for honey). With the caravan they were attacked over and over by barbarians wanting their stuff. They then go to the Orlanthi. Then to the White Rags. Then to Epitatenus' group where friendliness happens. Graves sits near lute guy and eventually falls asleep. Tired. Trolls wake and we sleep. New guy in a Ren Faire cloak comes in alone while we are asleep. Torath goes to meet him: Taylen.

 

Lute player goes into cave area (followed by Graves) and comes back w new food. Normally we would start bidding at 3pm but everyone is here. See stuff now. Two hour break. Then bidding.

 

Masked Man goes out and brings back first item:

--Spear of Destiny. Gold tipped. Mostly gold handle. Truth and sky runes.  Base on heaviness etc. mostly gold. Yelmalian matrices on it. Looks lately under heat or super-heated since forging. Esrolean use True Seeing lens. Det Gold is off the scale.

--2nd item is Magical Compass, cracked, perfectly working, will allow you to find ANYTHING :-) Looks like a genuine compass but the parts that spin on ours may not work correctly on this one. Not a trivial crack. Detects as Magic. What was the last thing searched for? Intriguing. The last thing wasn't found!

-- Humanoid Armor made from skin of Dragon Newt one rank below the Inhuman King, from the Second Age, looks like plate style but lighter and more elegant - full coverage not needing full articulation. Looks like the 1984 Dune Fremen Still sutis. Has been worn a lot and in battle. Several sliices didn't penetrate despite being made by a a Great Axe. Worked like leather in intricate patterns (6-8 months of workmanship). Size 15. Det Mgc yes Det Spirit yes. The Orlanthi go apeshit.

--The God's Blood Bowl: half shell geode much larger then the one Torath used. Missing some characteristics of Torath's. Don't believe that all these GB crystals could come from same geode - a construct. Alleged to have multiple attuned simultaneously. Something feels wrong to Torath.

--walks out fully functioning reduced sized mechanical lion. Clicking sound. Jresteli artfact from Second Age. Mainly mechanical  magical heart. Will run forever. Bracelet of command comes with it. Its joints look like my egg. curiosity. Not for fighting.

--Healing wand of unparalled power. Wood/rock w no matrixes. Det Mgc yes. Does not heal diseases. Torath stabs his own arm and is healed. Epitatenus offers Kost. They chop off and reattach his leg w no ill effects.

 

Bidding will begin in two hours or when everybody is ready.

 

Spear of Destiny goes to White Rags for 62, 423L. No one bids against them. Epitatenus wins the Magical Compass without too much competition for 45 kL, and the bidding for the Dragonewt Skin Armor is heated until Epitatenus also wins it for 150kL. Orlanthi got the bowl for 40kL after Cog's rude interruption. We get the lion for 45kL. Esrolians get wand for 20kL. 

 

Epitatenus and Actrinus chat. The former says he will leave with the armor and allowing his thralls to remain behind in Pavis with some funds for their troubles.

 

Our group headin gback includes the Orlanthi, Esrolians, and Actrinus. Every Esrolian is decked out in battle magic and are weapons masters just like we are. After a few fights it become clear we won't be stopped by anything short of SERIOUS. Graves successfully traps very young Rubble Runners to train for himself and Crazy.

 

Wind Stasis Storm 1603

Back in Pavis. We part ways. Lunars leave together, leaving money. Esrolians thank us and leave. Two days later Kost's leg is revealed as moving but it is not living. For aesthetic reasons he has it cut off but will have it regrown by the ShallonAroy.We go to EeN.

 

Elejan el Nadir looks at Lion and thinks we got a great deal. Intends to send it straight to Esrolia.

 

Torath, Graves, and Phasia go after Esrolians to make an offer for the undead wand. The tracks are gone but Graves Find The Path spooky-flawlessly. Torath tells them the problem with the wand. Cog rolls on checkmarks while we are gone. They have run tests and it is twice as powerful as what is required to restore a limb. Unable to cause enough of a wound that "restoration" not possible. Will go to Zorak Zoran on Shadow Plateau to offer it? We could take it off theri hands. Phasia Specials bargain and we get it for 15kL.

Four days back to town.

The Orlanthi came to sell Elejan 50 God's Blood crustals and a Ball of Tales. He opted out.

If we go to Esrolia to sell the lion to his buyer (tough bargainer w unlimitetted pockets) we shoudl get 80-90kL at least.

Wand: Fight/survive into the swamp of Delecti the Necromancer. He offers whatever. You accept. Getting out is easier.

Bison Riders control the middle of the waste.

 

In Pavis

Ten days of check mark clearing etc. Graves finds that the Eurmal temple has been used and has a date scrawled on it: Wildday in second week Sacred Time. Peri buys two five point POW potions. Same for Cog, Phasia. Torath trains Peaceful Cut w his tribe and finds shaman to get healed of cough. Phasia works for Elejan. Graves shifts Bound Spirit to Falcon.

3.5wks to end of Sacred Time - training from Clay Illusion Storm

Elejan estimates a 60kL profit for us of which he is willing to forward us 7kL against our %. 875L each

Torath performs Great Hunt.

Phasia gives 200L donation for Issaries High Holy Day. Elejan tells story of Issaries during Lightbringer Quest. A tribe of people nobody could understand knew the next step of getting to Hell. He invented Trade Talk to help them communicate. After second Day of Prayers - initiate rune magic returns.

Peri trains Cog to climb. Graves learns Speed Dart (500L), Det Mgc (300L), and more Pelorian (250L)

Sacred Time Carnival/Mummers Troupe watching

 

Graves goes to the Eurmal Temple on the date (above). Five people are there + Tesserson - all from the carnival. Tess completes a ceremony: drawing on ground, some words, all feel like entering into holy zone (not protective but opening door for magical opportunities). To be a Runelord Graves must 1) master Acting and 2) prior to meeting any more Lunars and getting into Lunar culture must become Illuminated (without meeting a Solar -> speak to Greybeard and answer his riddles).

 

To ingratiate with Lunars: They will attempt to determine if they can trust Graves. Then they will Illuminate him. He must be an master of acting and Illuminated prior to their detection spells. The only cult that teaches acting formally is Crarsht (Hungry One of Ogres) - so be careful of acting teachers :-) Donandar, God of Musicians and Entertainers, teaches acting as well.

 

Graves runespell Lies to tell Tesserson he is already Illuminated and wins. T believes him - now only mastery of acting remains, though Graves will follow up on actual illumination as well. Eurmal thinks the use of Lie is humorous enough and grants him the use of Lie back again, as this is his high holy day.

cards.name: RQ 20110910
cards.content:
{{+date}}

[[Don McClure|Don]], [[Lisa WilliamsCraig|Peri]], [[Joanie Albee-Good|Phasia]], [[Joe Good|Cog]], [[Brandon WilliamsCraig|Graves]], [[Tim Schlaak|Tarkal]], [[Ted Greer|Torath]], [[Sivan Marcus|Clayton]], Brendan as Crazy, and Ryan as Gohan the Barbarian

 

During Sacred Time Gohan spent time with his tribe. Praxis is verdant. They are at a prime oasis. Torath goes on his hunt and returns. Gohan plays a lot of training games and has fun. Tarkal visited MEridian, gives her the choker (complete with 8wheels). 5-6000 Praxians means Stormbull Storm Kahns, but no incidents occur.

Back in Pavis, Tarkal visits Greybeard who agrees to keep the Godsblood geode while we are away.

 

God (last) Day Sacred Time 1603

Elejan asks Phasia to take Clayton (Sivan) along at least as far as Esrolia. Clayton worships Beulaia and Shailaha.

Peri returns to strive for an allied spirit and succeeds with one POW restoration potion. She undegoes a transforamtion into being a Rune Lady of Daka Fal - visible confidence boost and +1 CHA. Spirit (no species maximum) is 4d6+6 = 21 POW so any runespells it has are usable. Int 14. 1 point warding spell from being an Ancestor who protected the hearth. 4 point Shimmer spell. Peri has her spirit sacrifice three points for Resurrection. Priestess offers recommendations: learn Spirit Speech and, if you come to those who want higher levels in Daka Fal, assess their character and help/hinder people who help/hurt others, ask Daka Fal for spell to summon specific ancestors.

She takes us to Gimpy's where all the Orlanthi recognize Crazy, who knows many Sartarite drinking songs, and Cog is NOT happy that he joined their cult. Huge party where Peri buys the first three rounds and Clayton admits he was abandoned and just needs somewhere to be.

 

Freeze Disorder Sea 1604

Waking up at home with a hangover. Cog heads for general market for fruits and vegetables, threatening to crush the vendor if anything is not fresh. 18L. Cog goes to McCleary's for a slave and commands him to cook for Torath and Peri. His cooking is insufficient and he gets left to a beating.

Prep to leave: 5 wheels from Graves party wheels for Artos household requirements.  Graves takes the menagerie (William, Falcon, 2 juvenile Rubble Runners in training, 1 riding sable)

Buy large 4 animal cart and Rations (12 person weeks dried + 20 person weeks fresh) for 760L

Peri goes to Elejan (not looking so good since returning from his quest) who suggests:

route > Pairing Stone to Adari to Jaldon's Tooth

Use as little magic going in to the swamp as possible - and go in a single day to the center

Rislan is the Esrolian (majoirty of his money since the Pharoh has ruled. Likes exotic things. We don't have to sell to him. A better buyer might become available elsewhere.

Lunar Empire: two types of people - friends and foes. Armor and weapons we carry not allowed. Might travel back roads or find another way around. RE trolls, anybody from any race who will become 7Mothers lay member is trusted. Orlanthi must convert. Others may keep their cult ties.

Notchet City is covertly dangerous to anyone with money, like us.

--Come back tomorrow to get messages to take to various folks.

Graves studies with Greybeard. Library in Notchett City (close to Jrusteli) can be VERY interesting. Also City of Glamour.

Southern Sartar toward Nochet City from Willm's Church. Road between (south of) Whitewall  - trollwoods dangerous but protect from Chaos. The Haunted Lands are interesting (Leaden Hills NW Troll stronghold) - minor gods and goddesses with few worshippers who travel the HL and thereby don't fade into history. Easier to contact spirits.

{{Graves notes|closed}}

Cog talks to a Frist Through the Breach Argan Argar how to go. Reply: Travel as far south as Whitewall and skirt the north side of the Haunted Lands.

 

Peri will take letter to brother in Notchett City for Elejan.

 

Wind Disorder Sea 1604

Headed for the Badlands. This time of year there are bushes, greenery, flowers. Beautiful weather. Three days uneventful travel.

God Disorder Sea 1604

Bison Tribe hooks us up with food and three more sable to pull the 4 animal cart. Graves performs a lay/balad poorly and everbody leaves but Clayton and Crazy who clap mindlessly as best they can. Phasia asks if the shaman will help Peri learn Spirit Speech later. Graves moves on to successful grappling.

Freeze Harmony Sea 1604

Four days of lightest travel ever to Pimper's Block.

Wind Harmony Sea 1604

Large southern area for wagon trains. 20L + 1L/wagon/day to use the "city".  2 nice Lunar buildings (painted red - shrines to Ateries and one 7Mo) and two dozen not so much. Torath goes into a Lunar building following a sign in Praxian that says "Come in to learn more about the West." The explanation is being as a guest in a Chiefton's Tent (you bring no weapons and don't kill his other guests' horses).

 

Phasia (et al) goes to the market for a quarterstaff. We speak with a guy,  ,who takes weapons and armor from this border to another for 400L flat. He whispers that there may be less direct ways to get stuff across and Peri invites him to a beer later. He comes dressed not as a Lunar but as non-descriptly as possible. He needs a guarantee we won't pass on info about the pass and 200L. Road from Pimper's Block leads directly to Swenstown. The one he proposes is South and ends up south of Swenstown. We must meet him in the morning if we want to close the deal.

 

We opt to go down the East side of the mountains instead of going in to Lunar territory. By Hinder's Ruins. Block looks larger every day.

Next day Due west of Block and 2 days from Barbarian Town. Next day must cross river heading from Mountains - 20ft wide and Graves swims to discover it is 6ft deep. The lion weighs 450lbs. We head up river to cross at a tributary. Phasia falls from her bison as it bolts and falls over the edge, taking 9pts ignoring armor to her right leg. The bison lunges on and over the edge to its death. Phasia heals herself and Cog climbs down to lift her back up. With Phasia riding with Torath, we press on until we find a crossable section aprox 6-7ft across. Graves and Crazy carry the lion across.  We rope the cart towards the cliff face and Clayton successfully drives it across. Around 4pm Graves sees what Torath doesn't - the tracks of a barefoot woman. Since Torath doesn't see them, they get ignored as an hallucination and then followed by several of us. The tracks  fade into a glade. There is a large stump in the center. Torath crosses to see carvings he cannot read and puts an offering of rations on it. Cog recognizes it as an Elder language. Rustling of leaves unless there is a troll, then silence until he leaves. Peri's spirit, Loiosh, sees more spirits in the glade than are easy to count - all watching us intently. The stump "may have been a temple." We turn and go away but are followed by 3-4 spirits. Loiosh is sent to tell them we mean them no harm and hope vice versa is also true. They seem amenable.

 

At midnight Torath is waked by woman standing 8-9ft away - stark naked, 5'1', with male fantasty body. Trolls are awake but don't seem to see her. The trolls don't notice that Torath follows her uphill to the glade. Many of her friends are there, similarly endowed. She offers some of the food he left, he takes it and feels some euphoria. Advances are offered and accepted. Two hours later Cog notices. Cog calls Crazy and they fail their tracking roles. Cog wakes Graves who finds the tracks and wakes everybody to go uphill. Torath is walking downhill with a permanent point of POW, pants on backwards, big smile on his face.

 

We cross other tributaries with no problems, then Tarkal blows his role and takes 5 to his right leg - but we save his bison.

 

One day away from Barbarian Town spend night and stand usual shifts.

 

Next day make it to Barbarian Town, where people go to get weapons to go back and fight chaos (150-200 permanent residents), while Tarkal goes wide around it. It is the worst of barbarians separated from their tribes attached to an extreme religion (Stormbull) coming into town to blow their money before they die. PARTY!

Crazy prices throwing axes at 40L and flees, but Graves buys it for him for 5L less and gets reimbursed.

Crazy opts out of a throwing axe duel and being taunted by a Zorak Zoran who calls him a trollkin.

 

By early evening we've linked up with Cog and reached the base of the mountain range with Storm Walk. There is a storm at the peak. 30 or 40 people camped at the base. Half look like warriors with a bunc of wind markings. We greet them. Welcomed by "Pious Wind" (until Sartar is won again) west through Hendriki lands and norht through Grazelands to Wintertop. We are treated to classic Orlanthi hospitality. Graves performs a lay of Orlanth and only fails a little. The rest of the night is quieter than we might have expected. We each buy 35L wolf fur coverings to keep warm. Graves has to pay 45L. Next morning they head up Storm Walk mountain, pausing to point out safer road up.

 

We are attacked on a narrow ledge by dog-faced humanoids. We vanquish them, Peri heads into a cave Cog finds and routs a few more herself, and we move on into Hendrikei Lands (safe area in which we may roll on checkmarks).
